title: Staff People Integrations Engineer
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 126 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

Location: Remote - United States

Reddit is looking for a Staff People Integrations Engineer to own, maintain, and scale the integrations that connect Workday with Reddit’s expanding People technology ecosystem.

This role sits within the People Platform team and is responsible for ensuring critical employee, candidate, contractor, benefits, identity, and workforce data moves reliably, securely, and efficiently across Reddit’s People systems. You will own the health and evolution of our Workday integration portfolio while partnering closely with People Product Managers, P&C Operations, Analytics, Talent, Total Rewards, Fin Apps, Security, IT, and People leadership to connect new technologies and translate business needs into scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Workday integrations and strong experience connecting Workday with a broad range of enterprise and People systems. You are also comfortable with advanced Workday reporting, calculated fields, APIs, data mapping, integration security, monitoring, troubleshooting, and automation. Experience with SQL, cloud data platforms, and data pipelines is valuable as we expand the team’s data engineering capabilities over time.

If you’re energized by making systems work seamlessly, solving complex technical problems, and building the data flows that enable great employee experiences, this role is for you.

What You'll Do:

Workday Integrations & Ecosystem Connectivity

  • Own the health, maintenance, enhancement, and support of Reddit’s Workday integration portfolio and the broader connections across our People technology ecosystem.
  • Develop and support Workday Studio integrations, EIBs, Core Connectors, Cloud Connect integrations, APIs, and web services.
  • Build and maintain integrations between Workday and adjacent People systems, and design scalable integration approaches as Reddit continues to expand its People technology stack.
  • Design and implement scalable automation solutions that reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency.
  • Own integration delivery across the full lifecycle: requirements gathering, solution design, build, testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, production support, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Establish strong monitoring, alerting, reconciliation, and incident-response practices; troubleshoot integration failures, investigate root causes, and implement durable solutions.

Workday Configuration & Reporting

  • Support advanced Workday configuration, including business processes, calculated fields, condition rules, validation rules, security-related troubleshooting, and configuration enhancements.
  • Design and maintain complex Workday reports, dashboards, and data extracts supporting operational, compliance, reporting, and analytics needs.
  • Partner with Product Managers and P&C Operations teams to translate business requirements into scalable Workday solutions.
  • Support testing, release management, and deployment activities for Workday enhancements and new capabilities.
  • Monitor Workday feature releases and evaluate opportunities to improve functionality and automation.

Data Pipelines & Emerging Capabilities

  • Partner with Analytics and enterprise Data teams to support reliable movement and transformation of People data for workforce analytics, reporting, AI-enabled workflows, and operational processes.
  • Support data movement and transformation into OneModel, BigQuery, AWS Redshift, and downstream reporting tools, while identifying opportunities for the People Platform team to assume greater ownership of People data pipelines over time.
  • Support data validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance across People systems.
  • Contribute to data models, mappings, SQL transformations, lineage, testing standards, and operational runbooks based on team priorities and demonstrated experience.
  • Improve monitoring, observability, and support processes across the People systems landscape.

Technical Standards & Governance

  • Partner with the Senior Manager, People Platform to implement approved integration patterns, architecture standards, and technical governance practices.
  • Ensure solutions comply with security, privacy, audit, and change management requirements.
  • Support SOX controls, access reviews, change management processes, and audit requests as required.
  • Contribute to architecture reviews and recommend improvements to integration patterns, reporting solutions, and system reliability.

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Partner with People Product Managers to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
  • Work closely with P&C Operations, Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Security, IT, Analytics, Fin Apps and People leadership.
  • Evaluate new People technologies and advise on integration feasibility, reporting requirements, data flow implications, and technical implementation approaches.
  • Communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years of experience designing, building, maintaining, and troubleshooting Workday integrations within People Technology or enterprise systems environments.
  • Deep experience with Workday integrations, including Studio, EIBs, Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, APIs, and web services.
  • Strong experience with Workday calculated fields, advanced reporting, integration-related configuration, business processes, condition rules, and security concepts.
  • Experience developing and supporting complex Workday reports, dashboards, and data extracts.
  • Experience integrating Workday with recruiting, identity management, contingent workforce, learning, performance, engagement, or related People systems.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, REST and SOAP web services, authentication methods, integration security, data mapping and transformation, testing, monitoring, and secure enterprise integration practices.
  • Excellent debugging and troubleshooting skills across integrations, configuration, reporting, and security issues.
  • Ability to independently lead technical delivery from initial concept through implementation and support.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to partner effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to balance technical excellence with practical business needs in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus Points:

  • Workday Integration Certification.
  • Workday Pro certification in HCM or related functional areas.
  • Experience with Workday Extend, Prism, BIRT reporting, or similar advanced Workday capabilities.
  • Experience with workflow automation or iPaaS tools such as Workato, Tines
  • Experience supporting SOX controls, access reviews, or audit processes.
  • Experience with SQL, data modeling, ETL/ELT patterns, cloud data warehouses, orchestration, and production data pipelines; experience supporting analytics platforms such as OneModel is especially valuable.
  • Interest in helping the People Platform team expand its ownership of data engineering, analytics integrations, AI-enabled workflows, and automation over time.
  • Experience at a public or high-growth technology company.

title: Senior Network Administrator
description:
Overview

🌐 Lead the Network. Power the Mission. Join SOSi in Honolulu.

SOSi is on the hunt for a Senior Network Administrator to join our elite team at Joint Base Pearl Harbor Hickam in Honolulu, HI. In this pivotal role, you’ll ensure secure, compliant, and resilient network operations that support mission-critical communications across the Pacific theater.

From managing complex IT systems to solving high-stakes technical challenges, you’ll be at the forefront of enabling time-sensitive Command and Control (C2) strategies for over 5,000 users. If you're ready to elevate defense tech and make a strategic impact—this is your next move.

Essential Job Duties

As a Senior Network Administrator at SOSi, you will work within the Network Operations team to provide essential support within the Area-of-Responsibility (AOR). Your role includes monitoring, maintaining, and ensuring network availability, all while adhering to DoD regulations. You will be responsible for managing various network components, including LAN, BAN, WAN, telecommunications/transport protocols, Unified Communications/VoIP/Video Teleconferencing (VTC), WAN accelerators, load-balancers, firewalls, and cryptographic devices.

  • Configures and maintains Cisco routers, switches, Adaptive Security Appliances (ASAs), Taclane encryption devices, and Cisco Voice over IP (VoIP) systems to support efficient data flow within the network, while following established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs) when necessary.
  • Supports and troubleshoots External Border Gateway Protocol (eBGP) routing within a Palo Alto environment.
  • Implements and provides oversight of Commercial Solutions for Classified (CSfC) and Taclane encryption methods to protect sensitive data.
  • Provides essential support in the maintenance of VDI environments, ensuring efficient and secure user access.
  • Manages Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM), Video Teleconferencing systems (VTC)s, and other Cisco VoIP systems to ensure reliable communication services.
  • Serves as a point of incident escalation and coverage for network-related issues. Reviews and troubleshoots network transport and protocol related issues.
  • Collaborates with the Cross-Domain Solutions team to facilitate secure information sharing across security domains.
  • Acts as the primary point of contact (POC) for the project management team in support of the installation, configuration, and implementation of network equipment for new projects and requirements.
  • Actively participates in project coordination alongside the project management team to ensure successful project execution.
  • Liaises with POCs and customers to understand their network needs and provides appropriate solutions, including but not limited to List of Materials (LOM), proposals and related supporting documents (e.g., solution diagrams, implementation timelines, etc.).
  • Diligently follows guidance and direction from the Network Operations Lead, Deputy, and Operations Manager, adhering to established standards and procedures for network administration.
  • Participates in related solution technologies and special projects, as required.

Minimum Requirements

  • Active in-scope TOP SECRET clearance with SCI eligibility.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in IT, Networking, or similar, and 4 years of related experience or 8+ years of experience in network administration.
  • DoD 8570 IAT-II compliant (CCNA, CySA+, GICSP, GSEC, Security+ CE, CND, SSCP)
  • Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) or higher.
  • Expertise in Cisco routers, switches, ASA, Palo Alto firewalls, CSfC, Taclane encryption methods, VDI environments, Cross-Domain Solutions, CUCM, and VTCs.
  • Knowledge of network security best practices and compliance standards including government Secure Technical Implementation Guidelines (STIGs).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot network issues.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, adapt to changing network requirements, and effectively communicate with POCs and customers.
  • Able to support 24/7 operations (including support to exercises), when necessary.
  • Able to follow instructions and work both independently and in a (distributed) team environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Relevant IT certifications, particularly related to Cisco and network security (e.g., Cisco, Palo Alto, ITIL).
  • Familiarity with Department of Defense (DoD) protocols and procedures.
  • Experience with virtual infrastructure, VDI/thin-client, and VoIP deployments.
  • Knowledge of Forcepoint, Juniper, and other network technologies.
  • Proficient in Help Desk and software applications (Jira, Service Now, Remedy).
  • Awareness of Command and Control (C2) applications.
  • Experience in ITIL framework and best practices (e.g., Change Management, Configuration Management, Incident Management, Capacity Planning)
  • Customer-service oriented with a willingness to participate and assist.

Work Environment

  • Fast-paced and deadline-oriented work environment.
  • Potential for non-traditional working hours, including consecutive nights and weekends.
  • Occasional travel to locations within the supported Area-of-Responsibility (AOR).
  • Target Salary Range: $92,550 to $112,290.

Working at SOSi

All interested individuals will receive consideration and will not be discriminated against for any reason.

title: Payment Operations Lead
location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within United States
description:
In the early days of the telephone, switchboard operators were the invisible infrastructure of modern communication. They connected calls by hand, memorized patterns, resolved routing problems in real time, and kept whole cities speaking to one another.

Their work was technical, precise, human, and operationally essential. As networks grew, the best systems preserved the operator’s judgment while automating the repetitive paths.

Mercury is building a complete finance stack for startups. We work hard to create the easiest and safest banking* experience possible, so entrepreneurs and business owners can spend less time managing financial complexity and more time building what comes next.

Underneath that experience is a network of payment rails, bank partners, operational desks, controls, exceptions, and workflows that keep customer funds moving safely and reliably. These rails include international wires, domestic wires, RTP, ACH, and checks. When it all works, customers do not have to think about the machinery underneath. Their money lands where it should, when it should, with clarity and confidence.

We’re looking for a Payment Operations Lead to help build and scale the operational desks that support Mercury Bank’s payment rails. You’ll bring deep payments knowledge, strong team leadership, and a systems-minded approach to making operational work more efficient through process design, tooling, automation, and AI.

This is a high-trust role for someone who understands both the precision and pace required in payment operations. You’ll lead a team responsible for keeping money movement running smoothly across international wires, domestic wires, RTP, ACH, and checks, improving how work gets done, and building the operating rhythms, controls, and tools that help Mercury scale without losing quality.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Lead and develop a Payment Operations team responsible for supporting Mercury Bank’s payment rails, ensuring the team has clear priorities, strong operating standards, and the coaching needed to do excellent work.
  • Build and scale payment operations desks across international wires, domestic wires, RTP, ACH, and checks, including the workflows, escalation paths, controls, documentation, and quality standards needed to support reliable money movement at increasing volume.
  • Bring deep payments expertise to operational decision-making, helping the team navigate exceptions, investigations, returns, rejects, recalls, partner requirements, and the tradeoffs that come with moving money in a regulated environment.
  • Improve operational efficiency through better processes, tooling, automation, AI-enabled workflows, dashboards, and measurement systems that reduce manual effort while preserving judgment and control.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Compliance, Risk, Banking Partnerships, and other Operations teams to identify bottlenecks, improve workflows, and ensure payment operations are built for scale.
  • Define and track the metrics that matter for payment operations, including productivity, quality, SLA adherence, exception trends, control health, payment rail performance, and customer or partner impact.
  • Create a culture of ownership, urgency, and high quality, where the team understands not just what needs to happen, but why it matters for customers, partners, and Mercury.

You should:

  • Have + years of experience in payments, banking operations, payment operations, business operations, or a related operational function, ideally in a financial institution, bank, fintech, or regulated technology company.
  • Bring deep working knowledge of payment rails such as international wires, domestic wires, RTP, ACH, and checks, including money movement operations, payment exceptions, operational risk, controls, and the systems that support reliable payment processing.
  • Have experience leading, coaching, or managing an operations team, with a track record of setting clear expectations, improving performance, and building strong team operating rhythms.
  • Be excited to make operations more scalable through process improvement, tooling, automation, AI, documentation, dashboards, and thoughtful measurement.
  • Understand how to operate in a regulated environment, including how to balance speed, customer experience, risk, compliance, and operational quality.
  • Communicate clearly and calmly, especially when work is complex, cross-functional, urgent, or sensitive.
  • Have a high degree of ownership. You notice where the system is fragile, unclear, or too manual, and you take responsibility for making it better.
  • Be comfortable working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, Risk, Banking Partnerships, and other teams to turn operational realities into better systems.

Compensation:

The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits.

Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
WHY TEXTUS

TextUs on a mission to revolutionize business communication by enabling seamless and impactful engagement between workers and consumers. With a focus on innovation, ease of use, and delivering measurable results, our strategy is rooted in creating tools that outperform other messaging solutions while fostering trust and value for our customers and stakeholders.

At TextUs, every team member is empowered to make a difference. Our collaborative and data-driven culture, combined with the guidance of a proven leadership team, ensures you have the resources and support to excel. Together, we’re building the future of mobile-first, conversational engagement and redefining what’s possible for businesses and their stakeholders.

RESPONSIBILITIES

We're moving from a build cycle that hides intent inside Jira tickets to one that puts a spec at the center of every change. AI generates working code from a clear enough spec; if the spec is fuzzy, the code is too. The bottleneck moves from typing to thinking.

We run a V-shaped SDLC. The left side is intent: research, vision, spec, tests. The right side is verification: unit, integration, system, UAT. AI is changing the left side fast. Your job is to own the spec-to-verified-software loop so intent actually lands in production.

Product owns the upper 40%. They bring the customer research, the 1-3 year vision for where TextUs is headed, and the strategic framing of the bet. Engineering owns the lower 60%: the spec that turns vision into code, the acceptance criteria that defines done, the UAT that proves it works, and the working software at the end of it.

What you'll own

  • A feature area end-to-end, from spec authoring through verified production rollout
  • Translating product research and 1-3 year vision into specs the engineering org can build against
  • Specs that explicitly address tenancy, auth, rate limits, cost, observability, failure modes, and rollback
  • Acceptance criteria for every feature in your area, written before code is generated
  • UAT scenarios and the test artifacts that verify the system does what the customer expects
  • The codegen loop: scoping prompts, knowing when to stop and rewrite the spec rather than chase convergence, reviewing AI output against intent
  • Production health for what ships: telemetry, alerts, on-call response, follow-through on whatever broke
  • Pairing on spec authorship with less experienced engineers, raising the floor on what a "good spec" looks like across the team
  • Overall mentorship of junior and mid-level engineers

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years building production software in a team that ships fast and owns its own quality
  • Comfort with the customer side of the product, not just the engineering side. You can sit in a customer call, translate what you hear into a spec, and defend the trade-offs you made.
  • Strong fluency with Claude Code or equivalent agentic dev tooling. We expect AI-assisted development to be the default workflow, not a side experiment, and we'll evaluate that fluency directly in the interview loop.
  • Strong written communication. The spec is the artifact. If another engineer or an LLM can't build from what you write, the role doesn't work.
  • Track record of shipping in a Rails or comparable full-stack environment, with depth in at least one adjacent surface (modern frontend, mobile, integrations, data)
  • History of independent ownership: features you took from problem to production with light oversight
  • Bonus: experience with TypeScript, React, React Native, Chrome extension surfaces, or embedded web app contexts

Our stack

  • Ruby on Rails
  • Postgres or similar relational database experience
  • ElasticSearch or similar search technology
  • ActiveJob with AWS SQS, Sidekiq or similar background job system
  • AWS

How we work

  • Small teams, real ownership. The scope and the runway are there to ship the thing the right way, not just patch the version that exists.
  • AI-native by default. The expectation is that you use Claude Code (and whatever comes next) as part of how you actually work. We invest in the tools and the patterns.
  • Outcomes over output. We care that the right things ship safely, not that the dashboard looks busy.
  • We hire for judgment. Tooling will change; the instinct for where a system is going to break should not.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Initial Call w. HR (30 mins via Video)
    • Topics: Culture, logistics
  • Interview w. Hiring Manager (45 mins via Zoom Video)
    • Topics: Culture, skills, role overview
  • Rembrandt Assessment
    • The Rembrandt assessment allows TextUs to assess how your personality fits within the role and the TextUs culture.
  • Assignment (90 mins via Zoom Video)
  • Interview w. Cross Functional Team (60 mins via Zoom Video)
    • Topics: Culture, leadership, skills, role overview
  • Q&A w. CEO (30 mins via Zoom Video)
    • Topics: You will come prepared with questions about the role, team, product to ensure this role is the best fit for you.

EMPLOYMENT DETAILS

  • Job Type: Full time
  • Compensation Range: $140-150K
  • Location: Remote (US) / Headquartered in Denver, CO
  • Target Start Date: 2-3 weeks from offer date
  • # hires for this role: 1
  • Reporting to: Engineering Manager

By submitting your resume for this role, you consent to communication via text and email. There is no set deadline to apply for this job opportunity. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the search is no longer active.

TEXTUS BENEFITS INCLUDE

  • Competitive pay
  • Health / Dental / Vision Insurance
  • HSA contributions
  • 401K with company match
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Cell phone + internet reimbursement for $100/month.
  • One-time $1,000 home office stipend once you’ve been with TextUs for 6 months

We are committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment for all members of our staff, volunteers, subcontractors, vendors, and clients.

description:
Overview

The Intake & Authorization Coordinator plays a critical role in supporting Otterbein Universal's home health and hospice ministries. This position ensures timely, accurate, and efficient handling of intake calls, referral coordination, insurance authorizations, and admission processes. The role also supports payer verification, document management, and communication with referral sources. This position helps ensure a smooth and prompt patient experience while upholding Otterbein SeniorLife’s mission and core values.

Otterbein Universal Home Health provides Home Health services for the elderly, complimenting already strong independent senior services, outpatient capabilities and clinical facilities at Otterbein. This wide array of services establishes one of the most extensive portfolios of independent senior care capabilities in the state.

Otterbein Universal Home Health is a Medicare-certified home health agency with an established reputation for high-quality services. Otterbein Home Health services are an integral part of Otterbein Retirement Living Communities services portfolio and available to Otterbein West Liberty residents, in addition to residents in the surrounding area.

Providing a high level of personalized care, Home Health by Otterbein is guided by Otterbein’s nearly century-old tradition of faith-based ministry, clinical skills and strong community ties.

Hospice is a philosophy of care for those facing life-limiting illnesses, as well as their families and caregivers. The focus of hospice care is to help patients experience peace, comfort, and quality of life while also offering support and services to their family and caregivers.

At Otterbein Universal Hospice, our dedicated and compassionate team is here to help you through all stages of life’s journey. When the time comes for hospice care, our team will involve you and your loved ones in your care options, and together with you, develop a personalized plan of care. Our team includes nurses, a chaplain and social worker for your care and support. We offer the peace that comes with being cared for in your home.

At Otterbein, you’re more than an employee, you’re a Partner in Caring. Together, we work side by side toward a shared goal: delivering person-centered care that respects every resident and the choices they make.

Whether in our vibrant communities, our welcoming small house neighborhoods, Home Health, Hospice or Home Office, we provide the highest level of compassionate, quality care.

Join our team of Partners who are talented, kind, wise, funny, spirited, generous, endearing, and truly one-of-a-kind.

title: Finance AI Engineer
description:
Primary Function of Position:

The Finance AI Engineer designs, builds, and deploys the AI agents, skills, and semantic views that Finance runs on. This is a hands-on engineering role that turns repeatable finance workflows into reusable AI agents on Snowflake Cortex and CoWork, so that finance users can query complex data in natural language and get accurate, trusted answers. The engineer owns technical delivery end-to-end, from first prototype to stable production, and is the quality gate before any output reaches a finance stakeholder.

This role sits at the intersection of AI, data, and finance. The engineer embeds closely with finance teams to understand their needs, translates those needs into working solutions, and guides adoption of what they build. Success depends as much on communication and stakeholder trust as on technical depth, since the professionals who rely on these tools think in terms of financial models and business outcomes, not technical details.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Design and deploy scalable AI agents that automate repeatable finance workflows using Snowflake Cortex and CoWork
  • Build skills that allow non-technical users to complete full finance workflows in a single prompt
  • Create and own semantic views in YAML format that encode business context, financial metrics, and table relationships, enabling users to query complex data in plain English and get accurate answers
  • Develop and maintain SQL pipelines that feed the semantic views with accurate, up-to-date finance data
  • Run evals to measure the accuracy of the agents and refine the semantic views until outputs are reliable for finance users
  • Embed closely with finance teams to understand their needs and guide adoption of what you build
  • Own technical delivery from first prototype to stable production across multiple finance workloads

Required Skills and Experience

  • 2-4 years of experience in AI/ML or data science, with hands-on use of agentic coding tools
  • Proven experience creating semantic views in YAML format that encode business context, financial metrics, and table relationships (Required)
  • Firm grasp of LLMs and how context and prompt engineering influence model behavior and output quality
  • Strong working knowledge of Python and SQL
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to distill complex AI and data topics for non-technical audiences
  • Comfortable working directly with finance stakeholders to understand their needs and turn them into working solutions
  • Self-directed and able to take a loosely defined problem and drive it to completion with minimal oversight
  • This role requires working onsite in our Sunnyvale, CA office Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday every week

Required Education and Training

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Finance, Economics, or closely related quantitative field

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience supporting or exposure to Finance, FP&A, or Accounting is highly preferred
  • Familiarity in Tableau or other BI tools a plus

title: Systems Navigator (SN) - Fort Hood, TX
description:
The EFMP is a mandatory enrollment program that works with other military and civilian agencies to provide comprehensive and coordinated community support, housing, educational, medical, and personnel services to Families with special needs. Soldiers on active duty enroll in the program when they have a Family member with special medical and/or education needs requiring specialized services. EFMP ensures that a family member's needs are considered during the military personnel assignment process so their needs can be considered during the military personnel assignment process.


Systems Navigators and ACS Compliance Specialists (SNACS) - Exceptional Family Member Program (EFMP) - Systems Navigator (SN)


System Navigators are responsible for daily coordination to ensure the facilitation of networking between Families who have special needs and the systems of required care. Duties of the position include intake interviews and documentation, identification needs assessment of the Family member, referrals, follow-up care and information, advocacy, and collaboration with providers in both the civilian and military community.


Job Duties

  • Provide home visits for the Soldier and or Family members to offer support as needed and/or requested.
  • Coordinate with Government agencies and civilian service providers to identify the availability of non-EFMP respite care resources.
  • Maintain an information catalog of national, state, and local networks and contacts with military and civilian service providers who offer assistance to families with special needs.
  • Coordinate a support group and/ or workshops monthly.
  • Present EFMP Systems Navigation briefings to provide Soldiers and Family members an overview of available EFMP related services.
  • Provide information and referral services to Families by identifying appropriate resources and helping them make an informed choice of services available.
  • Partners with Families to increase resilience, develop self-advocacy skills, and improve their ability to navigate systems effectively.
  • Manage the Soldiers and Family member records in accordance with all required Army and DoD regulations.
  • Facilitate warm hand off to the appropriate program personnel when transitions occur.
  • Collects and explores data for planning, reporting, and program improvement, completed monthly reports meeting program deadlines.
  • Implements policies, procedures, and practices that connect Families to support services.

Required Skills/Qualifications

  • Knowledge of human service principles and practices, individual Family needs and problems relative to case management.
  • Knowledge of military, state and Federal laws, policies, regulations, and practices regarding medical, educational, and Family support services.
  • Possess skill levels to provide professional non-clinical case management services, facilitating connections between Families who have special needs and the systems of required care.
  • Ability to effectively communicate and interact with others, both in person and/or by telephone to conduct business.
  • Level 1 Life Coach certified through Certified Life Coach Institute (Provided by Patriot).
  • Must be able to travel.
  • Experience with Microsoft Suite programs.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
  • Must be able to pass a background check.

Required Education Level

  • Bachelor's degree in one of the following degree programs (social work, psychology; marriage, family, and child counseling; counseling or behavioral science; education; community health or public health).
  • Two years of experience in family related case management and/or social work.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

title: GTM Systems Engineer
description:
About Faire

Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

About this role

GTM Engineering builds and operates the intelligent systems, integrations, and automations that power Faire's GTM revenue org. We're the AI and technical backbone of GTM — accountable for the reliability, adoption, and continuous improvement of the tech stack. We're an AI-first team: we design intelligent workflows, build automation, and invest in the data foundations that make every capability we ship compound in value over time.

We're hiring a GTM AI & Systems Engineer to help build the next generation of AI and automation across Faire's go-to-market stack. This is a builder role on our GTM Engineering team — you'll design, build, and ship the agents, integrations, and workflows that take manual work off Sales and put Faire's data to work across the customer lifecycle.

You'll work across Salesforce, sales tools, and our growing AI/MCP tooling layer, partnering closely with RevOps, Sales, GTM Program Management, and Data & Backend Engineering to find the highest-leverage opportunities and turn them into systems people actually use. Every decision about what we build is made with an AI-first lens: agent before automation, automation before manual.

Why this seat

  • Wide latitude on the automation and AI layer — you'll help pick the highest-leverage problem, build it, and own how it runs, rather than execute a roadmap set for you.
  • A direct line from your work to a number the business feels: rep hours saved, pipeline surfaced, faster response times.
  • AI tooling as a first-class part of the job, not a side project you have to justify.

What you’ll do

  • Design, build, and ship AI agents and automations across the GTM motion: lead routing and scoring, account enrichment, sequencing and outbound support, deal support, and customer lifecycle signals.
  • Own and extend core parts of our Salesforce and GTM systems architecture alongside the rest of the GTM Engineering.
  • Contribute to Salesforce governance and DevOps hygiene as part of keeping the stack secure, reliable, and audit-ready.
  • Partner with our PAE team on the GTM data layer — Snowflake, Hightouch, Fivetran, Airflow, or related data tools — so usage and lifecycle signals reach the right system and trigger the right action automatically.
  • Partner with Sales, Success, RevOps, and Program Management to find where AI and automation create the most leverage, and turn that into working, adopted systems — not just proofs of concept.
  • Stand up evals, monitoring, and guardrails so every AI capability we ship is observable, reversible, and measured against a real business metric — pipeline influenced or rep time saved, not just uptime.
  • Set the bar for how AI shows up in Faire's GTM motion day to day — the data-quality standard, the review points, and the guardrails other builders on the team follow.
  • Help shrink the team's own keep-the-lights-on burden by identifying recurring operational work that's a good candidate for agent handling.
  • Track the AI and automation tooling landscape and bring the best of it into how Faire's GTM org operates.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years building automation, integrations, or tooling in a GTM, RevOps, or Business Systems context, with systems you've shipped and currently operate in production.
  • Hands-on Salesforce experience (declarative, Apex/SOQL, DevOps) and working familiarity with the modern GTM stack (ETL, Reverse ETL, Snowflake, Clay, Gong, GitHub).
  • Production experience with integration/automation tooling — Workato, Zapier, n8n or similar iPaaS/MCP/agent-builder platforms.
  • Working fluency with AI tooling — LLM APIs, agent/orchestration frameworks, prompting with agents or AI-driven workflows.
  • Judgment about where AI and automation genuinely help versus where they create risk — you know when to push automation further and when to pull back, and when to keep a human in the loop.
  • Comfort with SQL and enough Python or scripting to build and debug your own pipelines and integrations.
  • A builder-operator mindset: you'd rather ship something small and real than plan something big and theoretical, and once it's live, you keep making it better.
  • Strong written communication — you can explain what a system does and why to both engineers and go-to-market stakeholders.

Nice to have

  • Experience with BI, Snowflake, dbt, or other modern data warehousing tools.
  • Experience building or extending MCP servers or agent frameworks.
  • Comfort building lightweight internal tools or apps that give reps or ops a simple interface into a system.

Salary Range

San Francisco: the pay range for this role is $176,000 to $242,000 per year.

This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors such as transferable skills, work experience, market demands, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday). Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting.

Why you’ll love working at Faire

  • Move fast: You'll own meaningful problems that serve customers around the globe with the agency to move fast and see your results clearly.
  • Equipped to scale: We invest in what matters, including the latest enterprise AI tools, to help you work smarter and get more out of every day.
  • Best in class: Our team is full of sharp, kind, and generous colleagues who care about their craft and about helping you grow in yours.
  • Real rewards. Competitive pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits designed to support your life inside and outside of work.
  • Belonging: We're intentional about building an environment where every Faire employee has equal access to opportunities, growth, and success.

Faire was founded in 2017 by a team of early product and engineering leads from Square. We’re backed by some of the top investors in retail and tech including: Y Combinator, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Forerunner Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, and DST Global. We have headquarters in San Francisco and Kitchener-Waterloo, and a global employee presence across offices in Toronto, London, and New York. To learn more about Faire and our customers, you can read more on our blog.

Faire provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression.

Faire is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process and applicants with a disability may request to be accommodated throughout the recruitment process. We will work with all applicants to accommodate their individual accessibility needs. To request reasonable accommodation, please fill out our Accommodation Request Form (https://bit.ly/faire-form)

Privacy

For information about the type of personal data Faire collects from applicants, as well as your choices regarding the data collected about you, please visit Faire’s Privacy Notice (https://www.faire.com/privacy)

title: Litigation Counsel
description:
LITIGATION COUNSEL

About Carvana
If you like disrupting the norm and are looking to join a company revolutionizing an industry, then you will LOVE what Carvana has done for the car buying experience. Buying a car the old-fashioned way sucks and we are working hard to make it NOT suck. I mean, have you seen our vending machine?!

We are looking for people who are excited to thrive in an environment of impactful change. Team spirit is evident at Carvana, and every day we let our passions and creativity foster innovation. We take big swings, set ambitious goals, and challenge each other to make data- and process-driven decisions in everything we do. For more information on Carvana and our mission, learn more about what it’s like to work here from the people that already do.

About the team and position
Carvana’s Litigation Team is a high-performing group of attorneys, analysts, and e-discovery professionals who partner closely with every corner of the business. As Litigation Counsel, you will immediately take ownership of meaningful matters across our fast-growing consumer, commercial, regulatory, and securities portfolios. A portion of our docket is handled in-house, giving you the unique chance to brief motions, take discovery, and directly resolve disputes while still leveraging and managing top-tier outside counsel for the balance of the work. Our practice is deeply integrated with technology, automation, and AI—so if you are a self-starter who is curious, adaptable, and energized by solving novel problems in an opaque environment, you will thrive here and help us continue redefining how in-house litigation is done.

This role is in-person, Monday-Friday at our corporate headquarters in Tempe, Arizona.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own a portfolio of nationwide litigation and arbitration matters—from case intake through final resolution—spanning single-plaintiff lawsuits, class actions, regulatory investigations, and securities claims.
  • Develop and execute strategic, cost-effective case plans that balance insourced work with outside counsel engagement; draft key pleadings, discovery, and briefs where appropriate, and provide real-time guidance to business stakeholders.
  • Select, supervise, and evaluate outside counsel; drive alignment on strategy, budget, and performance while ensuring consistent, business-focused advice.
  • Monitor litigation trends, emerging regulations, and industry developments; translate learnings into proactive risk-mitigation and process-improvement recommendations for senior leadership.
  • Intake, analyze, and respond to questions from internal business units on a daily basis that touch on the company’s litigation or dispute risk profile.
  • Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by mentoring team members, sharing best practices, and championing innovative legal operations tools and approaches.

What you should know

  • J.D. from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar.
  • 3 to 5 years of hands-on litigation experience—ideally in both law firm and in-house settings—handling consumer, commercial, regulatory, and/or securities matters in federal and state courts, arbitration, and/or agency proceedings.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage all phases of litigation, including pleadings, discovery, motion practice, negotiations, and trial or hearing preparation.
  • Sophisticated verbal and written communication skills capable of building strong relationships and communicating effectively with stakeholders at every level and function of the organization.
  • Collaborative team player with exceptional judgment, business acumen, and ability to quickly assess business challenges, make timely, pragmatic recommendations under pressure, and identify, prioritize, and resolve issues quickly and independently.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and rapid change; a self-starter who is curious, tech-savvy, adaptable, and able to prioritize effectively and manage multiple tight deadlines in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Practical familiarity with e-discovery platforms, data analytics, and other legal-tech tools; enthusiasm for leveraging technology and AI to drive efficiency and improve outcomes.

What we’ll offer in return

  • Full-Time Salary Position with a competitive salary and Carvana stock compensation.
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.
  • 401K with company match.
  • A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more.
  • A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy both physically and mentally.
  • Access to opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge with others across the organization.
  • A company culture focused on high performance and bar-raising, with vast opportunity to learn and grow.

Other requirements
To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

  • Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English.

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

Legal stuff
Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. title: Jr. Data Center Operations & Systems Technician
description:
Who is Blueprint?

We are a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with a strong presence across the United States. Unified by a shared passion for solving complicated problems, our people are our greatest asset. We use technology as a tool to bridge the gap between strategy and execution, powered by the knowledge, skills, and the expertise of our teams, who all have unique perspectives and years of experience across multiple industries. What does Blueprint do?

Blueprint helps organizations unlock value from existing assets by leveraging cutting-edge technology to create additional revenue streams and new lines of business. We connect strategy, business solutions, products, and services to transform and grow companies.

Why Blueprint?

At Blueprint, we believe in the power of possibility and are passionate about bringing it to life. Whether you join our bustling product division, our multifaceted services team or you want to grow your career in human resources, your ability to make an impact is amplified when you join one of our teams. You’ll focus on solving unique business problems while gaining hands-on experience with the world’s best technology. We believe in unique perspectives and build teams of people with diverse skillsets and backgrounds. At Blueprint, you’ll have the opportunity to work with multiple clients and teams, such as data science and product development, all while learning, growing, and developing new solutions. We guarantee you won’t find a better place to work and thrive than at Blueprint.

We are looking for a Jr. Data Center Operations & Systems Technician to join us as we build cutting-edge technology solutions! This is your opportunity to be part of a team that is committed to delivering best-in-class service to our customers.

In this role, you will perform hands-on installation, cabling, hardware maintenance, system checks, and deployment support within a live data center environment. Working from established procedures and with guidance from experienced technicians, you will help maintain safe, secure, reliable, and well-documented operations. This role requires alignment with the client’s best practices and safety protocols.

Responsibilities:

  • Install, rack, stack, cable, label, and validate servers, network devices, storage systems, rack power distribution units, and associated rack and MOR cabling by following approved work instructions.

  • Perform documented hardware repairs, component replacements, rack moves, equipment deployments, and IT equipment decommissioning with appropriate guidance and escalation.

  • Complete daily system checks and preventive maintenance; review assigned alerts, tickets, and logs and escalate issues outside documented procedures.

  • Troubleshoot common hardware, imaging, connectivity, and configuration issues using approved diagnostic steps and knowledge documentation.

  • Support server imaging and deployment using approved MDT, WDS, PXE, or equivalent environments; apply operating system updates, patches, and baseline configurations.

  • Assist with basic device and network configuration, including IP addresses, VLAN assignments, DHCP, DNS, domain access, and device-to-device connectivity validation.

  • Update tickets, maintenance histories, repair records, inventory systems, asset records, and project trackers accurately and on time.

  • Verify equipment identity, location, status, and chain-of-custody information during deployment, maintenance, movement, and decommissioning activities.

  • Follow access controls, change procedures, data-handling requirements, safety practices, and applicable operational standards.

  • Communicate task status, blockers, safety concerns, and recurring issues promptly to senior technicians or appropriate stakeholders.

  • Maintain an orderly work area and participate in process, documentation, and operational-readiness improvements.

Qualifications:

  • 1+ year of hands-on experience in data center operations, IT hardware support, desktop support, field services, networking, or a comparable technical environment; relevant technical education or lab experience may substitute for professional experience.

  • Working knowledge of server components, network devices, storage hardware, structured cabling, rack layouts, and basic power concepts.

  • Foundational understanding of TCP/IP, IP addressing, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, and common connectivity troubleshooting.

  • Ability to follow detailed technical procedures, use ticketing and inventory systems, and maintain accurate documentation.

  • Strong attention to detail, safety awareness, dependability, and willingness to learn in a fast-paced operational environment.

  • Ability to work onsite, perform hands-on equipment tasks, and meet the physical and scheduling requirements of the assigned data center environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate degree, technical diploma, military technical training, or equivalent coursework in information technology, networking, electronics, or a related discipline.

  • CompTIA A+, Network+, Server+, Microsoft, Cisco, or equivalent entry-level certification.

  • Experience with server imaging or deployment tools such as MDT, WDS, or PXE.

  • Experience in a data center, network operations center, hardware lab, warehouse technology, or other controlled technical environment.

Salary Range

At Blueprint, we strive to offer competitive pay that reflects the value of our team members. Compensation for this role is influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographic market.

For candidates based in Washington State, the anticipated compensation range is from $26.44 to $32.69 USD/hour, with a midpoint of $29.57 USD/hour. Please note that we typically do not hire new employees at the top of the posted range. Actual starting pay will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity. The final salary and job title may vary depending on the selected candidate’s qualifications and could fall outside the stated range.

title: Vehicle Supply Technician
description:
Definition:

The Vehicle Supply Technician (VST) maintains a dual support role within the vehicle and supply divisions of Maricopa Ambulance. The primary responsibility of the VST is certifying a clean, safe and stocked environment for field operations staff to promote a quick and effective deployment of services.

Essential Functions:

  • Demonstrates complete knowledge, understanding and compliance of company policies and procedures.
  • Ensures that ambulance and all equipment is ready for use at the beginning of each shift. This includes but is not limited to appropriate cleaning and disinfecting of the interior and exterior of the vehicle, appropriate cleaning and disinfecting of equipment, completing daily checklists of the vehicle and equipment, inspecting and restocking the vehicle, and performing some routine maintenance.
  • Ensures security of buildings, vehicles, equipment and all other company property.
  • Performs daily inspections of base and/or station for cleanliness.
  • Appropriately and safely delivers the equipment or supplies to the appropriate locations.
  • Acts at all times with his/her personal safety in mind, as well as the safety of other support staff, EMS personnel, bystanders, and any other public safety personnel present.
  • Maintains security and privacy of all company and patient information at all times in accordance HIPAA and all other local, state and federal regulations.
  • Is familiar with and practices the Infection Control policies and procedures of the company. Adheres to Universal Precautions/Body Substance Isolation when necessary.
  • Reports to assigned shifts properly groomed in uniform and on time, unless the proper notification has been made. Remains on-duty and in proper uniform until properly relieved.
  • At all times sets an example of professionalism and leadership for others to follow.
  • Places patient welfare, care excellence, and safety above all else.
  • Performs other duties as directed by management.

Specific Duties:

  • Maintain supply, service, stocking, and decontamination areas and equipment according to protocol, and ensuring these areas are free of safety concerns
  • Report all unsafe conditions or practices to a supervisor
  • Drive company vehicles with due regard, abiding to all laws and company protocols
  • Clean and decontaminate the ambulance patient and crew compartments
  • Wash the exterior of the ambulance and other company vehicles as needed
  • General inspection of vehicles and proper reporting of damage or issues
  • Stock supplies and equipment in proper storage areas and company vehicles
  • Assist with inventory of supplies and equipment in supply room and company vehicles
  • Restock supplies and equipment on company vehicles preparing for service
  • Review all product expiration dates. Dispose of expired product in appropriate manner
  • Check, change, and/or replace main and portable oxygen tanks
  • Be knowledgeable regarding company equipment and routinely check equipment for proper functionality
  • Document and report equipment that does not function safely or work at all
  • Properly handle and dispose of biohazard materials
  • Accurately maintain computerized, manual, and paper records
  • Recharge and calibrate equipment batteries
  • Handle field crew concerns in a courteous manner

Reports To:

  • Support Services Manager
  • Other Operations Command Staff as appropriate for all operation activities.

title: Technical Lead - Radioactive Waste Disposal & Assessments
description:
Overview

Savannah River Mission Completion is seeking a Technical Lead - Radioactive Waste Disposal & Assessment to be based in our Aiken, SC location on the Savannah River Site.

The Technical Lead - Radioactive Waste Disposal & Assessment develops, implements, and defends technical assessments, calculations, computational models, and miscellaneous documents that support the long-term capacity of engineered and natural barrier systems to isolate radioactive waste at the Savannah River Site (SRS) from the surrounding environment.

Responsibilities

General responsibilities include:

  • Compilation of technical inputs (i.e., calculations, computational models, etc.) to produce multi-faceted environmental and radiological performance assessments (PAs) and safety case assessments.
  • Interfacing with facility engineering and operations, regulatory stakeholders, and Department of Energy (DOE) customers.
  • Contributing to the fulfillment of project and organizational objectives as a team member dedicated to demonstrating long-term compliance of radioactive waste disposal actions.

This is a multilevel posting. Candidate(s) selected to receive an offer will be offered the position level commensurate with their experience and qualifications.

Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Engineering, Geology, Computer Science or other related science degree from an accredited university or college
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Background with the Department of Energy defense programs and chemical processes.
  • Familiarity in flow and contaminant transport modeling calculations.

About

Savannah River Mission Completion (SRMC), a prime contractor for the US Department of Energy, is responsible for managing the Department of Energy’s Savannah River Site’s Liquid Waste operations contract. Located in Aiken, South Carolina, SRMC is a limited liability company formed by nuclear operations and environmental remediation global leaders BWXT, Amentum, and Fluor. The SRMC Team is responsible for the closure of waste tanks, the operation of the Savannah River Site’s Defense Waste Processing Facility, tank farm operations and associated production and disposal facilities. https://www.savannahrivermissioncompletion.com

title: Senior Systems Administrator
description:
Who is Blueprint Technologies?

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with a strong presence across the United States. We help organizations unlock value from existing assets by leveraging cutting-edge technology to create additional revenue streams and new lines of business. Our teams work across infrastructure, cloud, AI, product development, and enterprise solutions to solve complex technical challenges for some of the world’s most recognized organizations.

Senior Systems Administrator

We are seeking a Senior Systems Administrator to support advanced research and development lab environments focused on server infrastructure, hardware operations, test automation support, and enterprise systems administration. This role is highly hands-on and combines traditional systems administration with hardware deployment, infrastructure troubleshooting, lab operations, and environment management within fast-paced engineering and development ecosystems.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working directly with physical hardware and enterprise infrastructure while also supporting virtualized systems, operating systems, automation environments, and internal lab operations. This individual should thrive in technically complex environments where priorities shift quickly and collaboration with engineering, development, and infrastructure teams is essential.

In This Role

In this role, you will support complex lab and development environments by deploying, maintaining, troubleshooting, and optimizing server and client infrastructure. You will partner closely with engineering and operations teams to ensure hardware, networking, virtualization, and operating systems are functioning reliably across test and development environments. You will also assist with lab expansion efforts, hardware lifecycle management, automation support, and infrastructure documentation while helping maintain operational excellence across multiple technical workstreams.

Responsibilities

  • Administer and support Windows Server and Linux-based lab environments
  • Deploy, configure, image, and maintain servers, desktops, laptops, and specialized test hardware
  • Build and support virtualized environments using Hyper-V and related technologies
  • Configure and troubleshoot Active Directory, DNS, networking, and remote access systems
  • Support hardware deployment activities including rack-and-stack, cabling, KVM configuration, and device onboarding
  • Perform break/fix troubleshooting across server, network, firmware, operating system, and infrastructure components
  • Conduct firmware updates, hardware diagnostics, and root cause analysis
  • Monitor and maintain lab infrastructure health, capacity, and operational readiness
  • Support test automation and engineering teams with infrastructure setup and maintenance
  • Configure and support remote management tools such as iLO, iDRAC, KVMoIP, and console access systems
  • Maintain inventory, asset tracking, and operational documentation
  • Coordinate equipment moves, deployments, and decommissioning activities
  • Utilize ticketing and operational management systems such as ServiceNow or equivalent
  • Participate in infrastructure planning, environment optimization, and operational improvement initiatives
  • Ensure compliance with operational, safety, and security standards

Work Breakdown

  • 60% Systems administration and infrastructure support
  • 25% Hardware deployment, troubleshooting, and lab operations
  • 10% Documentation, ticketing, and operational coordination
  • 5% Meetings and cross-functional collaboration

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience preferred
  • 5+ years of systems administration experience in enterprise, lab, or infrastructure-heavy environments
  • Strong experience supporting Windows Server environments
  • Experience with virtualization technologies including Hyper-V
  • Hands-on experience with server hardware deployment and troubleshooting
  • Experience supporting networking infrastructure and cabling within lab or data center environments
  • Familiarity with Active Directory, DNS, imaging, patching, and endpoint management tools
  • Experience with remote management platforms such as iLO, iDRAC, KVM systems, or equivalent
  • Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills across hardware and software systems
  • Experience working within fast-paced engineering, R&D, or test lab environments preferred
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and documentation skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and respond effectively to operational issues
  • Ability to lift and move equipment as needed within lab environments
  • Ability to work onsite in Redmond, WA

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting pre-production or engineering lab environments
  • Experience with SCCM, Azure, or enterprise endpoint management tools
  • Experience supporting firmware validation or hardware testing environments
  • Familiarity with Linux administration and scripting
  • CompTIA A+, Network+, or similar infrastructure certifications
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale deployment and automation environments

Salary Range

At Blueprint, we strive to offer competitive pay that reflects the value of our team members. Compensation for this role is influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographic market.

For candidates based in Washington State, the anticipated salary range is $38.46 to $48.08 USD/hour, with a midpoint of $43.27 USD/hour. Please note that we typically do not hire new employees at the top of the posted range. Actual starting pay will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity. The final salary and job title may vary depending on the selected candidate’s qualifications and could fall outside the stated range.

Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Physician for Modern Vein Clinic (Part-Time Opportunity / Comprehensive Training Provided)
location: Multiple Locations (FL, IL, NY, PA, TX)
description:
Metro Vein Centers is a rapidly growing healthcare practice specializing in state-of-the-art vein treatments. Our board-certified physicians and expert staff are on a mission to improve people’s quality of life by relieving the painful, yet highly treatable symptoms of vein disease—such as varicose veins and heavy, aching legs.

With over 70 clinics across 8 states, and still growing, we’re building the future of vein care—delivering compassionate, results-driven care in a modern, patient-first environment.

We proudly maintain a Net Promoter Score (NPS) of 93, the highest patient satisfaction in the industry.

Welcome to Vein Care Done Differently

Metro Vein Centers is seeking Part Time Physicians to support our regional clinics. We are looking for physicians from all medical specialties who are passionate about patient care to join our rapidly growing team. We are currently hiring physicians for part-time clinical positions (approximately 20 hours per week) in the following locations:

  • Chicago, IL Area: Naperville, Orland Park
  • Florida Area: Miami, Orlando, Tampa, Jacksonville
  • Houston, TX Area
  • New York City, NY Area
  • Philadelphia, PA Area

Our clinical leadership team is proud to offer comprehensive, hands-on vein care training. No prior vein or vascular experience is necessary, though we are always interested in speaking with doctors already serving patients in the field. Our incredible team of vein specialists originally came from many different medical specialties. If you want to provide care that positively impacts people’s quality of life and lead a clinical team in doing just that, you’ll fit right in.

Who You Are

  • MD or DO degree; board certification in your specialty
  • Excellent leadership and interpersonal skills—a great listener, compassionate communicator, collaborative colleague, and motivating team champion
  • Committed to providing high-quality, patient-centered care with integrity and thoughtfulness
  • Enthusiastic about learning and applying new knowledge and techniques
  • Eligible to obtain medical licensure in the state of your Metro Vein Centers clinic

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Compensation: $400,000 – $650,000+ Full-Time Range (Pro-rated based on actual part-time schedule of ~20 hours/week)
  • Consistent, reliable work-life balance (no on-call, no weekends, consistent schedule)
  • Meaningfully improve people’s quality of life by relieving the often painful and highly treatable symptoms of vein disease
  • Comprehensive, hands-on vein care training program for physicians from all specialties
  • Physicians are the leaders in their clinics while being empowered to solely focus on patient-care (full admin and clinical staff support, marketing and patient experience resources and best practices, end-to-end billing and insurance management, etc.)
  • Metro Vein Centers proudly maintains both a best-in-class physician retention rate and an NPS of 93, the highest patient satisfaction in the industry

Compensation and Benefits

  • Industry-leading compensation, with significant upside based on performance
  • Paid time off (as in actual time off where no one interrupts your vacation)
  • Coverage of medical malpractice insurance
  • Reimbursement for all applicable licenses and board certifications
  • Continuing education stipend
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

Healthy legs. Happier lives.
At Metro Vein Centers, we believe exceptional care begins with an exceptional experience. Our mission is to make vein care approachable, empowering, and connected to overall well-being. From the first conversation to the final follow-up, every patient interaction reflects our commitment to compassion, expertise, and trust.

A team united by purpose.

title: Local P&D Driver (Class A - Fully Endorsed)
description:
Job Summary:

  • Responsible for safely operating a tractor/trailer in the transportation of freight in accordance with Company, Federal, State and Local laws with regard to run times and Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) regulations
  • Must adhere to all FMCSA requirements of those holding a Commercial Driver’s License
  • Maintain records required with compliance with local, state and federal regulations
  • Comply with all requirements for safe and legal transportation of hazardous materials
  • Insure security of equipment and cargo
  • Conduct pre-trip and post-trip inspections to ensure safe working conditions of the tractor and trailer prior to each trip and at the end of each trip
  • Check gauges and visual indicators for malfunctions, ensure seal or lock on trailers and conducts inspection of vehicle before and during trips to determine problems that may be occurring
  • Promptly report all maintenance problems to Fleet Services and/or supervision
  • Verify unit numbers versus paperwork given and report any discrepancies to your supervisor
  • May be required to use in-cab technology, to include electronic logs and other items
  • May be required to drive different schedules and work the dock based on business needs
  • As approved by Safety, will be allowed / needed to run over-the-road on occasion, as dictated by business needs

  • Will assist where needed based on business requirements: Dock work to include loading/unloading freight, Customer site loading/unloading freight

Operational, safety and other needs may require the employee to perform any and all other duties as assigned. Employees are expected, and must be able to perform all such duties and tasks.

  • High School Diploma or General Educational Degree (GED), or any combination of education and experience, which would provide an equivalent background
  • 21 years of age required per FMCSA regulations (1 year driving experience required)
  • Must possess a valid Class A Commercial Driver’s License
  • Must be registered with the FMCSA Drug and Alcohol Clearinghouse
  • Must reside within 75 miles of the domiciled Service Center and/or work assignment
  • HazMat, Tanker and Doubles endorsements required (LCV requirement may apply)
  • Must be able to drive a tractor trailer for a period of time that will conform to FMCSA requirements
  • Stable employment history preferred
  • Ability to operate a forklift (minimum 7,500 lb. vehicle)
  • Must be able to push or pull a loaded pallet jack and/or hand truck with a minimum load of 70 lbs.
  • Physical activities include: standing, lifting, twisting, turning, climbing a ladder, etc.
  • Must be capable of dropping/hooking and coupling trailers which involves cranking landing gear, pulling 5th wheel pin which takes approximately 65 lbs. of pressure; and maneuvering a trailer dolly
  • Must be able to provide an acceptable MVR
  • Must be familiar with state motor vehicle laws and FMCSA rules and regulations
  • Must pass a FMCSA required medical exam
  • Must pass a road test
  • Ability to meet the FMCSA’s requirements to speak and read English
  • Must be able to lift approximately 70 lbs., or more if required by the essential functions of the job
  • Must be able to drive all routes and in all types of terrain, including, but not limited to, mountains, steep inclined roads, curvy highways, desert areas, bridges, tunnels, etc.
  • Must be able to drive in a wide range of environmental conditions, including, but not limited to, rain, wind, snow, freezing temperatures, hot weather, etc.
  • Must be able to operate all safety and operational functions of equipment, including, but not limited to, chaining tires, driving manual transmission vehicles, etc.
  • Must be able to comply with all company policies, rules, procedures and Code of Conduct
  • Must be able to interact well with others
  • Must be able to work independently, or in a team setting
  • Must be capable of working under tight time constraints in a high volume environment with multiple priorities
  • Responds well to questions; Ability to read, interpret and comply with written information and documents such as safety rules, operations / procedure manuals and maintenance instructions with a high comprehension and concentration level to include the ability to meet deadlines
  • Must pass a pre-employment drug screen, random drug and/or alcohol tests, and will be subject to a criminal history background check
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States
Physical Demands:
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to lift and/or move a minimum of 70 lbs. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel and reach with hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to lift, twist, turn, and may climb. The employee is frequently required to stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl and talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to sit and climb or balance.

Work Environment:
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to work near moving mechanical parts and fumes or airborne particles. The employee may be required to work in high/precarious places, with hazardous materials, and in various weather conditions. The noise level in the work environment ranges from quiet to loud as required by the essential functions of the job.
