title: Platform Engineering Technical Lead
description:
Clarity Innovations is a trusted national security partner, dedicated to safeguarding our nation’s interests and delivering innovative solutions that empower the Intelligence Community (IC) and Department of Defense (DoD) to transform data into actionable intelligence, ensuring mission success in an evolving world.

Our mission-first software and data engineering platform modernizes data operations, utilizing advanced workflows, CI/CD, and secure DevSecOps practices. We focus on challenges in Information Warfare, Cyber Operations, Operational Security, and Data Structuring, enabling end-to-end solutions that drive operational impact.

We are committed to delivering cutting-edge tools and capabilities that address the most complex national security challenges, empowering our partners to stay ahead of emerging threats and ensuring the success of their critical missions. At Clarity, we are people-focused and set on being a destination employer for top talent, offering an environment where innovation thrives, careers grow, and individuals are valued. Join us as we continue to lead innovation and tackle the most pressing challenges in national security.

Position Overview

The Principal Platform Engineer position is part of a dynamic team at the forefront of prototyping infrastructure designs to support the next generation of cyberspace operations. In this role, you will contribute to developing a platform that simplifies complex infrastructure management across cloud-native and on-premises environments. Your work will involve scalable systems architecture, implementing GitOps workflows for version-controlled and automated operations, and designing declarative interfaces to create tools and processes that bridge the gap between development and operations while enhancing productivity and reliability in diverse infrastructure settings. This role presents unique opportunities, such as regular customer interaction to iterate, streamline, and multiply platform capabilities to meet customer objectives of broad deployment and exceptional flexibility. You will be expected to provide architectural design leadership, systems design leadership, and elegant solutions to pressing operational challenges.

Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate delivery and deployment of operational capabilities
  • Participate in architectural discussions and lead design of Kubernetes-based GitOps deployments
  • Lead design and implementation of pipelines with Break-Build SATS and DAST
  • Ensure OCI hardening of container images lifecycle
  • Manage the chain of custody of Container signature lifecycle provenance
  • Communicate through thoughtful and thorough design documents for new initiatives
  • Design and implement robust, scalable, and secure cloud infrastructure solutions aligned to overall product vision
  • Build and integrate automated testing into the product’s codebase
  • Foster a collaborative team environment, mentor junior engineers, and coordinate efforts across cross-functional teams to ensure project success

Qualifications

  • Able to obtain and maintain a TOP SECRET security clearance (note: only US Citizens are eligible for security clearances)
  • Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline (degree requirement can be met with four years of hands-on experience in a full-time software engineering or similar position.)
  • Able to collaborate as a team but execute independently
  • Thrives in a high-trust, adaptable team environment
  • Proficient in Open Policy Agent management
  • Experience using CNCF technologies such as envoy, spinnaker, Istio, Keycloak, minio etc.
  • Proficient in CNCF container networking ingress and egress
  • Proficient with CI/CD pipeline-based GitOps deployments
  • Proficient with Kubernetes cluster lifecycle (deployment, troubleshooting, scaling)
  • Proficient with container orchestration using Kubernetes
  • Proficient deploying and managing Kubernetes clusters on major cloud platforms, particularly Azure and AWS
  • Proficient in containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Podman)
  • Proficient with Infrastructure as Code Utilities (e.g. Terraform, Pulumi, Crossplane)
  • Proficient in Linux-based development environments (e.g., Ubuntu, RedHat Enterprise Linux, or derivatives)
  • Experience implementing modern DevOps practices and tools (e.g., CI/CD, IaC, GitOps) in production deployment workflows
  • Experience providing daily guidance and oversight to other engineers
  • Experience contributing to or leading the design of new capabilities
  • Experience leading communications with customers and end users
  • Experience troubleshooting network connectivity issues
  • Experience with a version control code repositories, such as GitLab

Preferred Qualifications

  • Current Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility
  • Able to obtain and maintain a TOP SECRET security clearance (note: only US Citizens are eligible for security clearances)
  • Familiar with operations in cyberspace domain
  • Experience designing and implementing solutions on Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services
  • Familiar with Scaled Agile Framework
  • Experience writing automated tests (e.g., unit tests, acceptance tests, system /integration tests)
  • Expertise in Cluster API and multi K8s cluster management using Liqo.io
  • Experience using crossplane.io for Hyper Converged Infrastructure (HCI)
  • Proficient in Security as code (e.g., OSCAL)
  • Proficient in Software bill of materials and software supply chain management to ensure attestation of code lifecycle
  • Experience writing code in a general-purpose language such as Python, Go, or Rust

Salary: $123,000 - $310,000

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

title: Lead Technical Product Manager
description:
About Numan
Founded in 2018, we’ve already grown to be a 300+ team distributed across the globe, united by a singular mission: empowering people to take control of their health.
Numan is transforming health: we’ve built a cutting-edge platform that integrates diagnostics, medication, supplements, digital programmes, and doctor consultations. Giving people the tools they need to maximise life.
To deliver on our transformative mission, we are guided by our 5 company values:
• Patients first.
• Learn fast.
• Own the quality.
• Succeed together.
• Care deeply.
Backed by top-tier investors, Numan is already having a positive impact on hundreds of thousands of patients here in the UK, and we want you to help us deliver this mission!

The role:

This role is about taking our platform to the next level: moving toward sophisticated, predictive, and learning-based decisioning, with a clear path toward becoming a regulated medical device.

This is a senior, high-impact individual contributor (IC) role for someone who combines deep system understanding with clinical product judgement and real experience deploying AI/ML. You are AI-enabled, well-resourced, and measure your success by what you ship and move, rather than the size of your team. You move comfortably between high-level strategy and engineering-grade specifics.


You'll be:

  • Lead the product direction and roadmap for the decision platform, from long-term strategy down to the detail of how a rule actually works.

  • Decide which features and capabilities create the most scalable value, balancing near-term execution with strategic bets.

  • Establish and systematically track the success metrics for the platform.

    • Set the direction for how the platform uses AI and machine learning, embedding predictive and supervised learning systems into production.

    • Build self-learning systems so the platform continuously improves on its historical recommendations while keeping safety and explainability central.

    • Read and reason about system architecture. Act as a credible equal in technical debates with engineers, making sharp trade-offs between speed-to-value and long-term scalability.

      • Help shape the product side of the platform's regulatory direction, including the decision to build it as Software/AI as a Medical Device (SaMD).

      • Work fluently with sensitive patient data, partnering with clinical and quality colleagues to ensure safety and patient trust fundamentally shape the roadmap.

        • Proactively show engineering, clinical, design, and other product teams what the platform makes possible, while staying pragmatic about what they can absorb today.


You'll need:

  • A proven track record as a Senior or Principal Technical PM on complex platform, infrastructure, or systems products.

  • Hands-on experience deploying machine learning in production, specifically supervised learning or predictive systems.

  • Experience deploying or regulating software/AI as a medical device (SaMD), or working within closely comparable regulated frameworks.

  • Direct experience working with rules engines, knowledge graphs, or AI-driven decisioning systems.

  • Experience in clinical, healthcare, or adjacent domains handling sensitive, highly detailed user data.

  • Experience operating as a high-velocity individual contributor who leverages AI tools to cover ground that would traditionally require multiple people.


    • It's a bonus if you have:

  • Experience scaling platform products across multiple international regulatory frameworks.

  • Prior experience working directly as a data scientist or software engineer before transitioning into technical product management.

  • Experience dealing with complex biological or personalized health data points.

title: QA Salesforce Lead
description:
Job Overview:

As part of Perficient, the Salesforce QA Lead is a pivotal role responsible for overseeing the entire quality assurance project life cycle. This position entails collaborating closely with project managers to gather high-level requirements, collaborating with management for estimating and resource allocation, and providing leadership and guidance to a team of QA Engineers dedicated to the project. The Salesforce Quality Assurance Lead actively engages in SCRUM ceremonies to gain a comprehensive understanding of business needs, development approach, subsequently formulating a test strategy and planning that involves QA resource allocation. This person is the main point of contact for QA activities coordination between upper management, scrum master, lead developer, release engineer and business analyst. This person should be able to take decisions and push back whenever the team is full of capacity. This position requires solid communication and reporting to upper management.

  • Collaborate with project managers to elicit high-level requirements.

  • Work closely with management to estimate project timelines and allocate necessary resources.

  • Supervise and guide a team of QA Engineers assigned to the project.

  • Actively participate in SCRUM ceremonies to align testing efforts with business needs.

  • Develop a comprehensive test strategy to ensure the highest quality of software products.

  • Continuously monitor QA tickets and manage assigned QA resources effectively.

  • Request, prepare, configure, and manage test data and test environment.

  • Design test scenarios and develop test cases.

  • Execute manual testing and collect, analyze, and communicate test results.

  • Identify, report and track incidents, defects, or bugs until its resolution; perform root cause analysis as required.

  • Lead triage efforts to address issues promptly and efficiently within the QA team.

  • Proactively plan for potential regression testing requirements to maintain product integrity. i.e. Spring, Summer and Winter Salesforce releases.

  • Monitor production environments for potential issues, and when issues arise troubleshoot side by side with the business analysts ensuring swift resolution.

  • Collaborate closely with business analysts to troubleshoot system functionality and alignment with requirements.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all QA-related matters throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Possess a deep understanding of the system's architecture to inform testing strategies effectively.

  • Facilitate clear and regular communication with upper management, providing comprehensive reports on QA progress and outcomes.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor degree in Computer Science or Information Technology related disciplines.

  • 5+ years of experience in QA and Testing Projects.

  • 1+ years of experience in QA Lead position.

  • High English written and verbal communication skills to build a trusting relationship with major project stakeholders.

  • Strong analysis abilities and a high level of customer service to perform exceptional work.

  • Strong understanding of software development processes and Agile methodologies.

  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.

  • In-depth knowledge of Salesforce architecture and functionality.

Required Skills

  • Experience developing and executing tests in Functional Testing, Integration Testing, System Testing, User Acceptance Testing and Regression Testing.

  • Solid skills administrating Test Management and Defect Management tools. Tools (e.g., ALM, Test Manager, Bugzilla, JIRA, Zephyr, Azure DevOps, etc.)

  • Proficiency in Salesforce CRM platform. Comprehensive knowledge on (Configuration & Setup, Object Manager & Lighting App Builder, Data Management, and Workflow/Process Automations)

  • Proficiency in API testing and API testing tools like Postman.

  • Proficiency in Integrations with Salesforce. Being able to understand external systems that interact with in the system that finally interact with Salesforce.

title: VP, Account Management - Pharma/Life Science
description:
At MERGE, we are Built Different. We are a marketing and technology agency purpose-built for the intersection of health and wellness—where human impact matters most. By weaving storytelling through technology, we move beyond traditional engagement to Whole Human Marketing. This approach recognizes that humans are multidimensional and complex, and uses AI to ensure every brand interaction feels natural, contextual, and relevant.

This commitment to human-first innovation is what brings us together and propels us forward. We are united by our North Star: to unite people and brands to empower healthier, happier lives.

Emerge to the Top of Your Career

At MERGE, we strive to create a superior work experience where talented and ambitious people grow. An experience that encourages people to think higher and feel deeper. An experience where people engage their minds and hearts to do the best work of their careers.

As our VP, Account Management you will…

Step in as both a team & business Leader and a trusted strategic advisor. You are a visionary relationship builder who thrives on steering high-impact healthcare accounts, guiding passionate cross-functional teams, and serving as the trusted advisor C-suite executives rely on. In this role, you’ll own a $5–7M book of business, driving integrated campaigns across both HCP and DTC audiences, inspiring agency talent, and shaping short- and long-term brand strategy. If you bring a growth mindset, deep pharmaceutical marketing expertise, and a knack for making complex commercialization initiatives look seamless, we’d love to talk!

What You’ll Do

  • Lead as a Strategic Advisor: Act as the primary advocate and trusted expert for our pharma and biotech clients, partnering directly with executive and C-suite leadership to align marketing initiatives with core business goals.
  • Drive Account Growth & Revenue: Direct a $5–7M book of business (a single large account or multiple key accounts), consistently delivering on revenue forecasts and uncovering innovative, incremental growth opportunities.
  • Orchestrate Omni-Channel HCP & DTC Campaigns: Oversee complex marketing programs, digital experiences, paid media, and multi-channel strategy spanning both Healthcare Professional (HCP) engagement and Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) audiences.
  • Guide & Mentor Teams: Lead, inspire, and manage cross-functional agency teams. You'll delegate effectively, foster a positive, collaborative culture, and actively mentor team members to help them level up their careers.
  • Set the Long-Term Vision: Bring a strategic growth mindset to every account, establishing dynamic short- and long-term roadmaps that keep our client brands standard-setting in their category.

What You’ll Bring

title: Registered Dietician
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE:

This role will be key in supporting our multidisciplinary healthcare team in delivering the "dietitian in the family" approach to engaging our members. We are looking for an experienced Registered Dietitian Nutritionist to provide personalized nutrition counseling and support for members participating in our disease management programs, such as obesity and diabetes. You will engage with our members in a caring, empathetic manner through 1:1 consultations, helping them achieve sustainable weight management and healthy lifestyle changes as they navigate their chronic conditions. The ideal candidate will develop educational content to support a healthy lifestyle and deliver virtual, evidence-based nutrition care and lifestyle counseling from a telehealth contact center environment, with excellent communication skills when interacting with members via phone, chat, and Rightway's App. A willingness to go the extra mile to provide outstanding nutrition care is essential to this role.

  • Denver Hybrid role: remote Monday, Wednesday, and Friday; in-office Tuesday and Thursday
  • Shift available: 9:00 am–5:30 pm MST
  • May require occasional holiday and weekend coverage based on member and program needs

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Conduct initial and follow-up nutrition counseling sessions with members, providing personalized nutrition plans and lifestyle recommendations to support a healthy weight
  • Deliver care through phone, chat, and/or video visits as part of Rightway’s Care Complete programs.
  • Track weight loss progress, assess nutritional needs and lifestyle behaviors, and set/monitor health and nutrition goals during initial and follow-up consults.
  • Develop strategies to help members manage GI side effects related to weight loss medications and prevent malnutrition during appetite suppression
  • Collaborate with the multidisciplinary healthcare team to coordinate and optimize the care process for patients on weight loss medications
  • Document patient progress, nutritional assessments, and care plans.
  • Stay current with evidence-based research on weight loss medications, nutrition science, and weight management strategies.

WHO YOU ARE:

  • Active credentialing as a Registered Dietitian (RD) by the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR) and/or Licensed Dietitian Nutritionist (LD/N)
  • Additional licenses in the red states are highly desirable
  • Bachelor's degree in Nutrition, Dietetics, or related field (Master's preferred)
  • Minimum 2 years of professional experience in dietetics, with demonstrated expertise in weight management
  • Experience with motivational interviewing and health behavior change techniques
  • Knowledge of weight loss medications and their impact on nutrition and weight management
  • Effective communicator who builds rapport and maintains a patient-centric, empathetic, motivational approach that supports long-term engagement and behavior change
  • Ability to translate complex nutritional science into practical, actionable recommendations for patients through various mediums (phone, chat, email, etc).
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, virtual contact center with back-to-back scheduled and ad-hoc interactions with members.
  • Accurately and promptly document member interaction, including but not limited to consultation and intervention notes, nursing care plan, and assessments.
  • Maintain a patient-centric, empathetic, and motivational approach that supports long-term engagement and positive behavior change.
  • Protect member privacy and maintain HIPAA compliance at all times
  • A private, interruption-free workspace where you can complete your job duties and consultations
  • Utilize provided technology effectively, including communication platforms, clinical software, and remote monitoring tools.
  • Support organizational goals for member satisfaction, clinical quality, and operational efficiency.
  • Reliable, flexible availability to work assigned shifts (including rotating holidays for member coverage), adjust hours as needed during surge or emergency periods, and maintain consistent attendance to support service levels and member access.

COMPENSATION: $34.00 - $40.86/hr

CYBERSECURITY AWARENESS NOTICE

In response to ongoing and industry-wide fraudulent recruitment activities (i.e., job scams), Rightway wants to inform potential candidates that we will only contact them from the @rightwayhealthcare.com email domain. We will never ask for bank details or deposits of any kind as a condition of employment.

ABOUT RIGHTWAY:

Rightway is on a mission to harmonize healthcare for everyone, everywhere. Our products guide patients to the best care and medications by inserting clinicians and pharmacists into a patient’s care journey through a modern, mobile app. Rightway is a front door to healthcare, giving patients the tools they need along with on-demand access to Rightway health guides, human experts that answer their questions and manage the frustrating parts of healthcare for them.

Since its founding in 2017, Rightway has raised over $200mm from investors including Khosla Ventures, Thrive Capital, and Tiger Global. We’re headquartered in New York City, with satellite offices in Denver and Dallas. Our clients rely on us to transform the healthcare experience, improve outcomes for their teams, and decrease their healthcare costs.

HOW WE LIVE OUR VALUES TO OUR TEAMMATES:

We’re seeking those with passion for healthcare and relentless devotion to our goal. We need team members that embody our core values:

1) We are human, first
Our humanity binds us together. We bring the same empathetic approach to every individual we engage with, whether it be our members, our clients, or each other. We are all worthy of respect and understanding and we engage in our interactions with care and intention. We honor our stories. We listen to—and hear—each other, we celebrate our differences and similarities, we are present for each other, and we strive for mutual understanding.

2) We redefine what is possible
We always look beyond the obstacles in front of us to imagine new solutions. We approach our work with inspiration from other industries, other leaders, and other challenges. We use ingenuity and resourcefulness when faced with tough problems.

3) We debate then commit
We believe that a spirit of open discourse is part of a healthy culture. We understand and appreciate different perspectives and we challenge our assumptions. When working toward a decision or a new solution, we actively listen to one another, approach it with a “yes, and” mentality, and assume positive intent. Once a decision is made, we align and champion it as one team.

4) We cultivate grit
Changing healthcare doesn’t happen overnight. We reflect and learn from challenges and approach the future with a determination to strive for better. In the face of daunting situations, we value persistence. We embrace failure as a stepping stone to future success. On this journey, we seek to act with guts, resilience, initiative, and tenacity.

5) We seek to delight
Healthcare is complicated and personal. We work tirelessly to meet the goals of our clients while also delivering the best experience to our members. We recognize that no matter the role or team, we each play a crucial part in our members’ care and take that responsibility seriously. When faced with an obstacle, we are kind, respectful, and solution-oriented in our approach. We hold ourselves accountable to our clients and our members’ success.

Rightway is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that believes in the strength of diverse thought, beliefs, backgrounds, and education. We foster an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated to drive the best business decisions possible. We do not discriminate on any basis protected by applicable law. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, need, and performance.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
About Numan
Founded in 2018, we’ve already grown to be a 300+ team distributed across the globe, united by a singular mission: empowering people to take control of their health.
Numan is transforming health: we’ve built a cutting-edge platform that integrates diagnostics, medication, supplements, digital programmes, and doctor consultations. Giving people the tools they need to maximise life.
To deliver on our transformative mission, we are guided by our 5 company values:
• Patients first.
• Learn fast.
• Own the quality.
• Succeed together.
• Care deeply.
Backed by top-tier investors, Numan is already having a positive impact on hundreds of thousands of patients here in the UK, and we want you to help us deliver this mission!

The role

As Numan enters an exciting new chapter of AI-powered analytics, we're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to sit at the core of our data platform and drive better decisions across the entire business.

This is one of the most varied analytics engineering roles in digital health. Your work will span multiple domains - from commercial performance and marketing effectiveness through to health outcomes analytics and clinical operations - giving you a genuinely broad view of the business and the full patient journey.

We are embarking on a strategic investment in AI-powered analytics, with a full remit to explore and adopt the latest and greatest technologies. You'll be shaping which tools, approaches, and practices Numan adopts as a company.

Reporting to the Head of Data Engineering and collaborating closely with data scientists, analysts, and stakeholders across the business.


You'll be:

  • Designing, building, and maintaining scalable, well-tested dbt data models that power analytics across commercial, marketing, health outcomes, and clinical operations domains.

  • Acting as a senior technical voice within the analytics engineering function, setting standards for data modelling, testing, documentation, and code quality.

  • Leading end-to-end delivery of analytical projects: scoping requirements, managing dependencies, identifying critical path and risks, and communicating progress to stakeholders.

  • Mentoring data scientist and analyst data modelling capabilities ; build a culture of best practices, code review, and continuous learning across the data team.

  • Partnering with clinical, commercial, and product teams to translate complex domain requirements into robust, well-documented data models.

  • Evaluating, trialing, and championing AI-powered analytics tooling - shaping Numan's strategic direction on emerging technologies and what we adopt as a company.

  • Driving data quality, reliability, and governance across the transformation layer, proactively monitoring consumption and resolving issues before they impact stakeholders.


    • We're looking for someone who has:

  • 3–5+ years of experience in an analytics engineering, data engineering, or business intelligence role.

  • Proven track record of owning end-to-end data model design across multiple business domains — ideally spanning at least two of: commercial, marketing, health outcomes, or clinical/operational analytics.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical audiences including clinical and commercial teams.

  • Experience setting technical standards and delivering high-quality work within a small, high-performing data team.

  • Self-motivated and pragmatic, with a strong instinct for high-impact solutions over over-engineering.

  • Genuine curiosity about AI and emerging analytics technologies, with a desire to help shape how Numan adopts them.

  • Expert-level SQL: window functions, CTEs, advanced aggregations, and cloud warehouse-specific optimisation.

  • Deep proficiency in dbt: models, macros, tests, packages, documentation, exposures, and CI/CD integration.

  • Strong working knowledge of Google BigQuery (or equivalent cloud data warehouse): query optimisation, incremental loading strategies, and cost management.

  • Experience with Looker (LookML) or an equivalent BI layer, with a solid understanding of consumption-layer design.

  • Dimensional data modelling expertise: star schemas, slowly changing dimensions, and when to denormalise.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to deliver clear, insight-led presentations that tell a compelling story to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Understanding of data privacy, governance, and compliance requirements — with particular sensitivity to regulated healthcare data.

  • Practical experience with AI-assisted analytics workflows, or a strong demonstrated appetite to work at the frontier of AI in analytics.


    • It's a bonus if you have:

  • Worked in a digital consumer scale-up, with experience of delivering high quality work at pace.

  • Hands-on experience evaluating or implementing AI/LLM tooling in a data or analytics context (e.g. semantic layers, natural language querying, AI-assisted documentation).

description:

Uprite Construction is seeking an experienced Superintendent to oversee ground up commercial and industrial construction projects throughout Southern California. This individual will be responsible for managing all field operations, ensuring projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. The ideal candidate has experience working for a general contractor, excels at leading field teams, and has a strong background in commercial construction. Experience with tilt up construction is highly preferred.

  • Drive a culture of safety, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

What You'll Bring:

  • 7+ years of Superintendent experience with a general contractor or comparable construction experience.
  • Proven experience leading ground up commercial construction projects.
  • Experience managing industrial construction projects including warehouse, distribution, manufacturing, or similar facilities.
  • Tilt up construction experience is highly preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of construction sequencing, scheduling, and field coordination.
  • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings and specifications.
  • Experience coordinating multiple subcontractors and maintaining project schedules.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and problem solving skills.
  • Proficient with construction management technology including Procore, Bluebeam, Microsoft Office, or similar platforms.

Preferred Experience:

  • Manufacturing facilities
  • Commercial office

  • Large scale ground up projects

Uprite Construction was established in 1991 as a multi-service construction company specializing in project site development, ground-up, new construction, renovations, and tenant improvements for the commercial and industrial sectors. Check us out at upritecomgmt.com!

description:
Additional Location(s): N/A

Diversity - Innovation - Caring - Global Collaboration - Winning Spirit - High Performance

At Boston Scientific, we’ll give you the opportunity to harness all that’s within you by working in teams of diverse and high-performing employees, tackling some of the most important health industry challenges. About the role:

Boston Scientific was recognized as a Glassdoor Best Place to Work in 2026, ranking No. 15 on the Top 100 list, reflecting the culture our employees experience every day.

The primary responsibility of this role is to support the Global Endoscopy division in executing its hybrid portfolio strategy, ensuring portfolio investment is allocated to initiatives with the greatest strategic significance and meaningful return on investment across new product development (NPD) and business development (BD). This role supports acquisition and venture capital analysis, due diligence, deal accounting research, research and development (R&D) modeling for new product development opportunities, and strategic plan development.

In this role, you will partner with the Business Development team and cross-functional stakeholders to develop financial models for potential acquisitions and support due diligence activities. You will also collaborate with marketing, R&D and franchise leadership to evaluate and prioritize new product development opportunities.

This position reports to the Global Endoscopy controller and provides significant exposure to the Endoscopy leadership team, as well as divisional, corporate and regional finance teams across the organization.

Work model, sponsorship, relocation:

At Boston Scientific, we value collaboration and synergy. This role follows a hybrid work model requiring employees to be in our local office at least three days per week. Boston Scientific will not offer sponsorship or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this position at this time. Relocation assistance is not available for this position at this time.

Your responsibilities will include:

● Perform pro forma financial modeling for potential acquisition and venture capital targets in partnership with Endoscopy and Corporate Business Development teams.

● Identify key integration activities and partner with finance and cross-functional teams to define solutions, ownership and implementation timelines.

● Lead R&D financial modeling for new product development initiatives across all franchises.

● Represent Finance during Collaborative Development Board and Project Investment Board meetings by preparing project teams to communicate financial metrics effectively and educating stakeholders on topics such as target costing and product life cycle financial principles.

● Lead the R&D portfolio financial planning process in partnership with the divisional strategy team by developing funding recommendations and presenting analyses to the portfolio committee.

● Perform financial analysis for portfolio and bullpen projects, including project investment, net present value, incremental revenue, margin and resource requirements.

● Manage the quarterly forecasting process for acquisition-related revenue and margin.

● Support the development of long-range strategic plans and executive presentations through financial modeling and ad hoc analysis.

● Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of financial processes.

● Foster and support an inclusive culture at Boston Scientific.

● Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics or business preferred.

● Minimum of 12 years' experience in financial analysis, planning and business support.

● Ability to work effectively in a complex, highly matrixed global organization while simplifying information for reporting and decision-making purposes.

● Strong financial analysis skills with exceptional attention to detail.

● Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications; experience with SAP and Hyperion preferred.

● Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

● Ability to consolidate, synthesize and communicate large volumes of financial information.

● Ability to work independently while serving as a trusted business partner.

● Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

● Strong leadership, organizational, process and time management skills.

Preferred qualifications:

● Master of Business Administration (MBA) or master's degree.

● Certified Public Accountant (CPA) designation.

● Experience working within a medium- to large-sized organization.

● Manufacturing industry experience.

description:
Mavis Tires & Brakes at Discount Prices - Automotive Mechanics


Put your career into high gear with Mavis Tires & Brakes at Discount Prices! We're looking for full-time Automotive Mechanics to join Team Mavis at one of our state-of-the-art automotive service, repair, and tire sales centers in the Middletown, NY area. With over 2,000 retail locations, Mavis is one of the largest tire sales and automotive repair chains in the United States.

About the Position of Automotive Mechanic

As Mavis's leaders in undercar repairs, our Automotive Mechanics are trusted to inspect, diagnose, and perform a wide variety of automotive services on customers' vehicles. Mavis's Automotive Mechanics perform a wide variety of undercar repairs, including brakes, struts, and shocks. Employee Benefits

At Mavis, we understand that our people drive our success. We provide our team members with competitive weekly pay, including weekly incentive compensation, a good working environment and an excellent combination of additional benefits like health, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer match, paid vacations, paid time off, paid holidays, life insurance, on-the-job training, and opportunities for career growth and advancement.

Qualifications

The following additional qualifications are preferred: (1) state inspection license(s); and (2) ASE Certifications in Automotive Maintenance and Light Repair (G1), Suspension and Steering (A4), and Brakes (A5).

title: Risk, Credit Risk, Workout & Restructuring, Vice President, Frankfurt
description:
RISK

Our Risk teams develop comprehensive processes to monitor, assess, and manage the risk of expected and unexpected events that may have an adverse impact on the firm. Risk professionals execute critical day-to-day risk management activities, lead projects, and contribute to the ongoing advancement of a robust risk management program. Effective coordination with executive management, business units, control departments and technology is critical for success.

WORKOUT & RESTRUCTURING TEAM

The Workout & Restructuring (W&R) team is a specialist group within Credit Risk (CR) that maintains primary responsibility (i) for managing the firm’s distressed and defaulted credit positions to maximize recoveries, and (ii) evaluating and structuring new transactions with distressed counterparties. Principal offices are in New York, Salt Lake City, London and Frankfurt to ensure global coverage of the portfolio. All major industries are represented, including consumer and retail, natural resources, financial services, TMT, and real estate. All major business lines are in scope, including Investment Banking, Asset Management Division, Global Markets and Private Wealth Management.

Workout & Restructuring team members are generalists, and the successful candidate will have the opportunity to work on distressed restructurings/re-capitalizations across the capital structure in different geographies within EMEA/APAC and multiple industries.

RESPONSIBILITES

  • Represent Goldman in complex debt restructurings involving multiple stakeholders (creditors, sponsors, management teams, external advisors)

  • Conduct in depth credit analysis including review of industry fundamentals, cashflows, qualitative factors and likelihood of default and formulate/recommend workout strategies to maximize recoveries

  • Identify early warning signs when a credit starts showing sign of weakness and escalate them to senior leadership so that the firm can proactively take actions and mitigate downside risks, as appropriate

  • Monitor the performance of counterparties in the distressed Watch List portfolio, including adherence to repayment terms and covenants

  • Represent the team/firm in interactions with regulators and external auditors regarding names on watchlist, including provisioning levels and workout strategies

  • Act as a mentor for junior members in the team. Develop and manage relationships with other areas of the firm, including Investment Banking/Capital Markets, Sales & Trading, Operations, Collateral Management, Legal, Compliance, Technology

EXPERIENCE & SKILLS REQUIRED

  • Minimum of 8-10 years of experience managing/leading complex debt restructurings across the capital structure in various jurisdictions in EMEA/APAC

  • Demonstrable track record over multiple years of independent decision making as well as the ability to work collaboratively in team settings.

  • Advanced corporate finance, restructuring, and financial accounting skills

  • Strong background in assessing legal documentation, including waivers, amendments, restructuring agreements, and related documents such as engagement letters for appointment of external advisors

  • Ability to lead and motivate diverse deal teams, providing guidance to and supervision of junior members of the team.

  • Ability to communicate with senior leadership within Goldman Sachs, both inside & outside of Credit risk.

  • Strong academics, ideally with a master’s degree in finance, engineering, economics or other quantitative areas/subjects

  • Excellent communications skills, including the ability to influence and build consensus

title: Aerial Technician
description:

Based in Leesport, PA, you'll maintain clients' equipment and deliver exceptional service throughout Berks County. Take the next step in your career with a team that will value and support you!

THE BASICS

Lift, Inc. is built on the strength of its people. As a 100% employee-owned company, every team member-from sales professionals to service technicians-has a direct stake in our success and future growth. We're a team of knowledgeable, well-trained experts who take pride in delivering exceptional customer service while supporting one another in a culture that's authentic, growth‑minded, and focused on learning.

At Lift, Inc., every role matters, your ideas are valued, and your initiative is rewarded with hands-on training, clear career paths, and ongoing development. With dealership locations throughout Central Pennsylvania, including Mountville, Lancaster, Carlisle, Leesport, and Williamsport, you'll find opportunities to build a meaningful career alongside people who genuinely care about their work, their coworkers, and the customers they serve.

Pay: Competitive hourly rate

Schedule: 7:00 am to 3:30 pm

Benefits:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Life insurance
  • HSA/FSA
  • PTO
  • Short- and long-term disability
  • 401(k) with match
  • Growth and development opportunities within a 100% employee-owned business

We'll provide you with a work vehicle, uniforms, an iPad, an iPhone, and PPE. You'll be paid for drive time and receive an annual allowance for tools and boots.

WHAT TO EXPECT AS OUR AERIAL TECHNICIAN

This role requires problem-solving skills and a general mechanical aptitude, as you'll be inspecting customers' equipment to figure out what's wrong and do what you can to fix the problem. You'll speak with customers about their concerns, diagnose the root cause of issues, and perform accurate repairs and maintenance. As you work, you'll follow all safety procedures and manage your time efficiently. You'll test the equipment when you're done, ensure safety decals are visible, and check that manuals are available. You'll keep clients' equipment running well and compliant with industry regulations.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to service locations throughout Berks County
  • At least 18 years old
  • High school diploma or technical automotive degree (or a similar field)
  • Valid driver's license and an acceptable driving record
  • At least 1 year of experience servicing mechanical, electrical, and/or hydraulic systems

It's not required, but experience servicing diesel and gas engines in construction, automotive, or industrial equipment would be preferred. We're also looking for candidates with demonstrated critical thinking and problem-solving experience as well as experience working independently.

Must have the ability to pass a background check and drug screening test.

title: Software Engineer, Embedded Agentic AI
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

About the team

Roku TV is where embedded systems, media experiences, and intelligent software come together at a massive scale. The Roku TV organization develops technology used on millions of TVs worldwide, and the team is already applying AI to challenging TV problems in resource-constrained environments where quality, performance, and reliability matter.

As part of this team, you will help define how agentic AI systems are designed, built, and operated for Roku TV use cases. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who treats AI agent design as an engineering discipline: architecting durable systems, grounding them in the right context, integrating them with tools and services, and making them reliable in production.


About the role

We are looking for a hands-on, systems-oriented Agentic AI Engineer to design, build, and maintain intelligent agents and copilots that drive automation, accelerate workflows, and unlock new product and platform capabilities for Roku TV. You will own the full lifecycle of agent development—from prototyping and architecture through orchestration, evaluation, deployment, observability, and continuous improvement.
You will contribute directly to Roku’s AI strategy by engineering reusable components, optimizing agent workflows, and ensuring strong real-world performance in production environments.

For California Only - The estimated annual salary for this position is between $170,000 - $210,000 annually. Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location. This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off.


What you’ll be doing

  • Architect, develop, and deploy AI agents and copilots for Roku TV use cases, integrating them with internal systems, tools, and services.
  • Own end-to-end agentic systems from concept to production, including model selection, prompt and context design, retrieval strategies, backend services, and conversational interfaces.
  • Design and implement single-agent and multi-agent orchestration patterns, including handoffs, delegation, and cooperative task execution.
  • Build scalable RAG and context pipelines that provide high-quality grounding for AI systems and keep them aligned with evolving data sources and business logic.
  • Implement tool-calling, function-calling, and MCP-style integrations so agents can safely take actions and interact with the systems around them.
  • Create reusable agent templates, modular components, and paved-path patterns that accelerate adoption across teams and use cases.
  • Establish strong evaluation, observability, and monitoring for conversation quality, task success rate, latency, cost, and overall system performance.
  • Build safeguards that improve production readiness and reliability, including testing pipelines, controlled rollouts, drift detection, and mechanisms that prevent error amplification in multi-step workflows.
  • Prototype quickly, run experiments, and translate successful ideas into durable, scalable software solutions.
  • Partner closely with engineering, product, QA, infrastructure, and cross-functional teams to deliver meaningful business and customer outcomes.

We’re excited if you have

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field.
  • 2+ years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, backend development, or adjacent domains, with strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to build production-grade systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, plus experience with C/C++ or another systems language.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM-based systems, including prompt design, retrieval, tool use, memory handling, and agent orchestration patterns.
  • Experience building and maintaining RAG pipelines, agent frameworks, MCP servers or equivalent function-calling architectures, and conversational interfaces.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, REST APIs, containerization, and modern deployment environments.
  • Experience with observability, evaluation, experimentation, and feedback loops for AI systems in production.
  • Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, move quickly, and deliver incrementally in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication skills, sound engineering judgment, and a collaborative working style.

Nice to have

  • Experience with multi-agent frameworks or orchestration systems such as LangChain, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel.
  • Experience with video, audio, TV, or edge-device environments, especially where latency, cost, and hardware constraints matter.
  • Familiarity with ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Research experience, paper implementation experience, or a habit of applying emerging GenAI techniques pragmatically to real problems.

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

title: Senior AI/ML Backend Engineer
description:
About Lyra Health
Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

We are looking for an experienced Senior AI/ML Backend Engineer who is eager to build the backend services for our AI/ML product features that make a significant impact within the organization. The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic about taking ownership of their work and spearheading cross-functional projects.

Lyra is for you if you

description:

title: Tax Supervisor – Tax Reporting & Forecasting
description:
The Tax Reporting & Forecasting Supervisor is a key member of the Southern Company Services (SCS) Corporate Tax team and reports to the Income Tax Reporting & Forecasting Manager. This Supervisor role will be responsible for the income tax accounting, SEC tax reporting, tax forecasting, and tax regulatory filings for the MPC Registrant; however, they will also be a contributing team member to the Southern Company Gas registrant. The position has three primary areas of responsibility: Tax Accounting, Tax Forecasting, and Regulatory Tax Support. In the Supervisor role, this position includes 2 direct reports and provides formal coaching, feedback, and performance evaluations. Additionally, as a contributing team member, this role will provide cross-training and serve as an example to other less experienced team members. The ideal candidate brings strong ASC 740 tax accounting knowledge, sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while working effectively with management and key stakeholders.

  • Lead and support the technical tax accounting capabilities of the MPC & Gas tax team on Federal and State income tax matters.
  • Review quarterly consolidated SEC financial statements and underlying workpapers to ensure accurate, consistent, and well-supported income tax reporting. This position is also responsible for approving monthly income tax entries and certifying the tax controls for MPC are performed and operating effectively by the team.

  • Review monthly and quarterly account reconciliations, provision workpapers, and tax analytics; investigate significant variances and reconciling items; and develop practical recommendations to support timely resolution and accurate reporting.

  • Research, analyze, and help resolve tax accounting issues, business transactions, and other matters affecting the tax provision process, while serving as a technical resource and escalation point for team members. This includes discussing and presenting new or complex tax items.
  • Support technical issues and planning initiatives by updating memos, presenting analyses and recommendations to management, leading meetings, and coordinating effectively with stakeholders and operating company contacts.
  • In collaboration with the Regulatory teams, provide tax calculations required in the ratemaking process for MPC and Gas regulated entities. This includes providing narratives on tax items that are of interest to our Commissions along with new and emerging items from changes in tax law.
  • Coordinate and review responses to internal and external auditor requests and other information requests, ensuring timely, accurate, and well-supported deliverables.
  • In collaboration with the MPC and GAS Finance forecasting team, lead the tax forecasting capabilities of these registrants including modeling the impact of future tax law changes, changes in the capital investments of the business and divestiture/acquisitions.


Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related field required, master’s degree in accounting or tax preferred.

  • Certified Public Accountant (CPA) designation preferred.

  • Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in income tax accounting and/or tax reporting, including demonstrated experience of being effective in areas discussed below required.
  • Public accounting and/or large corporate tax department experience preferred, including experience with income tax accounting processes and workpapers.
  • Experience with tax provision software (such as PowerPlan), ERP systems (such as Oracle), and advanced Excel-based analysis preferred.
  • Experience using software to add efficiency and improve processes is preferred.

Skills, Abilities, and Technology

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical tax matters clearly, present issues and recommendations to management, lead discussions effectively, and build strong working relationships across departments and operating companies.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret financial data, identify issues, and develop practical solutions in a complex tax environment.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously, exercise sound judgment, and deliver high-quality work in a timely manner while coordinating team activities and supporting less experienced staff.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop others by providing day-to-day guidance, reviewing work, sharing technical knowledge, and supporting performance development for direct reports and other team members.
  • Sense of urgency, when required, and a strong bias for action and timely work product whether individually contributed or through team efforts.

  • Work to complete design details and plan sets
  • Assist in the preparation of engineering and construction cost estimates

title: Director of Instructional Systems
description:
The Director of Instructional Systems (DOIS) is responsible for driving the consistent, high-quality implementation of instructional systems across an assigned portfolio of KIPP Texas schools.

Reporting to the Managing Director of Instructional Systems (MDIS), the DOIS ensures that academic priorities translate into clear, actionable expectations for schools. In close partnership with the MDIS, the DOIS supports the ongoing refinement of key structures and data components, building and adjusting what is necessary to strengthen implementation and ensure systems remain clear, usable, and sustainable across schools. This includes translating strategy into well-defined processes, frameworks, and data structures that support strong instructional decision-making and day-to-day execution, as well as aligned instructional support structures (e.g., CTMs, practice clinics, and professional development) that enable schools to effectively respond to data.

The DOIS is accountable for how instructional systems show up in practice—how they are used by leaders, how consistently they are executed, and whether they lead to improved instruction and student outcomes. This includes supporting School Leadership Teams not only in analyzing data, but in building and executing the instructional routines and supports needed to translate insights into improved teaching and learning.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES:

Instructional Systems Design and Maintenance

  • Lead the design and build-out of instructional data systems, including assessment trackers, progress monitoring tools, and data dashboards.

  • Design and support aligned response systems (e.g., CTMs, practice clinics, and professional development) so School Leadership Teams can act on data.

  • Translate academic priorities into clear workflows, templates, and expectations for school teams

  • Build reporting structures that enable leaders to quickly identify trends, gaps, and root causes

  • Ensure all tools are intuitive, streamlined, and aligned to the realities of school operations

  • Develop and codify non-negotiables for system usage to ensure consistency and rigor across all primary schools

  • Refine reporting structures and practices used by leadership to monitor academic performance and instructional effectiveness

Systems implementation and Execution

  • Lead the rollout of instructional systems, including but not limited to, assessment practices, progress monitoring cycles, and data routines

  • Model, co-facilitate, and coach school leadership teams to execute instructional systems across their schools

  • Establish clear expectations for how these systems are used by school management and school-based teams

  • Work alongside SLMs to support strong execution, providing targeted, direct guidance where implementation is inconsistent

  • Monitor execution across regions, using observation and leader feedback to identify strengths and gaps

  • Ensure instructional systems are embedded in regular leadership and instructional routines

Systems Monitoring and Accountability

  • Track both the consistency and quality of instructional systems implementation across schools

  • Maintain accuracy and reliability of data structures and reporting

  • Engage school leadership in reviewing implementation trends and identifying areas for improvement

  • Distinguish between compliance and meaningful execution

  • Identify patterns that impact instructional quality and student outcomes

  • Address systems issues and challenges through clear feedback, support, and adjustments

  • Partner with the MDIS to surface risks and contribute to academic health insights

Instructional Practice and Systems Coherence

  • Support leaders in accessing, interpreting, and applying student performance data within instructional systems

  • Support school leadership in using data to inform planning, instructional best practices and decisions

  • Reinforce strong routines for analysis and follow-through through ongoing support

  • Identify where data practices are inconsistent and work directly with leaders to strengthen them

Systems Refinement and Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with the MDIS to evaluate the effectiveness of instructional systems based on implementation data and school feedback

  • Identify where systems are not driving clarity, consistency, or strong execution

  • Recommend and implement targeted adjustments to improve usability and impact

  • Simplify or adjust tools and processes that create friction or confusion for school leaders

  • Ensure system updates remain aligned to school-based realities and instructional priorities

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s preferred

  • Minimum 4 years of experience in education, including instructional leadership, data, or systems-related roles. Previous principal experience highly preferred.

  • Experience with data-driven instruction, assessment design, and progress monitoring systems

  • Demonstrated ability to build or implement systems that impact student outcomes

  • Experience working with or supporting school leaders or instructional teams

COMPETENCY AND SKILLS:

Instructional Systems Execution

  • Strong systems thinker with ability to

  • Strong ability to design and operationalize instructional systems and tools

  • Attention to detail in ensuring systems are functional, practical, and scalable

  • Ability to translate strategy into clear, executable structures

Data Systems, Insight, and Analysis

  • Skilled in building and managing data tools and reporting systems

  • Skilled in analyzing academic data to identify trends, gaps, and root causes

  • Ability to interpret data and support others in using it effectively

  • Strong focus on accuracy, usability, and actionability of data

IImplementation and Project Management

  • Proven ability to manage complex projects and drive execution across multiple stakeholders

  • Strong organizational skills and follow-through to ensure systems are implemented with fidelity

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high quality

Collaboration and Influence

  • Ability to work effectively across teams and functions

  • Strong communication skills to translate technical systems into user-friendly practices

  • Ability to influence without direct authority

Commitment to Student Outcomes

  • Relentless focus on improving student achievement

  • Deep belief in the potential of all students, particularly those in historically underserved communities

Physical Requirements:

  • The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

  • The person in this position needs to be able to move about inside and outside the school throughout the workday

  • The candidate is expected to attend conferences, meetings and training sessions both virtually and in person within the Region.

Additional Requirements:

  • Reliable transportation is needed for travel between campuses and across regions

  • Ability to maintain emotional control under stress

  • Work with frequent interruptions

Work Environment:

  • Reports to school or central office site Monday - Friday

  • Typical school/office environment with frequent interruptions

Travel Requirements:

Frequent travel throughout the state to KIPP’s multiple regions: Regular and consistent travel to various school sites, regional offices, or external locations for work related activities for professional learning, academic leadership, data reviews, meetings and other work related activities.

What We Bring to the Table:
● Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans with coverage options for employees and their families.
● Competitive vacation and flexible paid time off (PTO) policies.
● Paid family leave.
● Flexible spending account or high-yield HSA.
● Employee assistance programs.
● KIPP also offers the following employee-paid benefits: legal plans, LifeLock identity protection, life insurance and disability insurance.

EEO:
KIPP Texas is an Equal Opportunity Employer. KIPP Texas ensures equal employment opportunities regardless of race, creed, gender, color, national origin, religion, age, sexual orientation, or disability. Any individual needing assistance in making an application for any opening should contact the Talent Team.


Federal law requires employers to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job duties. Examples of reasonable accommodation include making a change to the application process or work procedures, providing
documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.

title: Principal Technical Product Manager
description:
ROLE SUMMARY

The Principal Technical Product Manager owns the deliverables for major areas of the Kepware product portfolio. Working from the product vision set by Product Management, the Principal TPM translates that vision into executable roadmaps and drives delivery across engineering teams, including distributed and consultant-augmented teams. This is a senior leadership role accountable for delivering working software at scale, and for setting the standard that other Technical Product Managers follow.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the product backlog and roadmap: translate the product vision into a clear, prioritized, actionable roadmap and backlog aligned to business objectives.
  • Drive delivery at scale: lead teams to deliver working software on predictable cadences across multiple product areas, removing blockers and managing complex cross-team dependencies.
  • Lead distributed teams: effectively run and coordinate teams across multiple geographies and time zones.
  • Manage consultant and augmented capacity: integrate contractor and consultant teams into delivery, setting clear expectations, quality standards, and outcomes.
  • Translate between business and engineering: convert the product vision and business goals into technical requirements the team can execute against, and communicate technical realities back to stakeholders.
  • Set the standard: model best practices in product execution and delivery; mentor and raise the bar for other Technical Product Managers.
  • Partner cross-functionally: work closely with Product Management, Product Marketing, Architecture, Engineering, Quality, Security, and Support to align on priorities and outcomes. Scope of ownership may evolve over time based on business needs. Contribute to product vision and strategy while respecting that vision ownership sits with Product Management.
  • Own delivery accountability: take responsibility for what ships, when it ships, and whether it meets the bar across the areas they own.
  • Ensure compliance with company standards and policies.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • The product areas have clear, prioritized roadmaps and backlogs that stakeholders trust.
  • Teams deliver predictably, with complex dependencies managed and blockers cleared.
  • Distributed and consultant teams are integrated and productive.
  • Other Technical Product Managers look to this person as the standard for the role.
  • The Principal TPM is the trusted owner for their areas - decisions get made, software ships, and quality holds.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Extensive experience as a Technical Product Manager, Product Owner, or equivalent role owning major product areas.
  • Strong track record of delivering complex software products to market on predictable cadences.
  • Experience leading geographically distributed teams.
  • Experience working with consultant, contractor, or augmented teams.
  • Strong technical foundation - able to engage credibly with engineering on architecture, tradeoffs, and technical decisions without needing to be the deepest technical expert.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate with autonomy in ambiguous, shifting environments.
  • Excellent prioritization, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience mentoring or setting standards for other TPMs.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in enterprise software.
  • Experience in the industrial manufacturing space.
  • Experience with modernization, migration, or platform consolidation efforts.
  • Familiarity with agentic AI / AI-assisted development workflows.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 10-15 years of relevant experience

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Hybrid

WHY THIS IS A ONCE-IN-A-CAREER OPPORTUNITY

  • Lead in a market undergoing significant disruption and growth from cloud migration to edge intelligence to AI-powered industrial automation.
  • Join a culture defined by ambition, authenticity, speed, teamwork, and the belief that manufacturing can meaningfully improve the world.
  • Competitive benefits, compensation and long-term impact on how the world’s industrial companies operate, automate, and innovate.

Why Join Velotic

Velotic is uniquely positioned at the intersection of industrial operations, advanced connectivity, and AI. Joining now means you can help shape:

Culture & Growth

  • Build foundational People Ops systems, processes, and culture from day one.
  • Work within a team defined by ambition, collaboration, authenticity, and speed.
  • Influence global operating models and employee experience at scale.

Work-Life Balance

  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Discretionary Time Off (DTO)
  • Global paid parental leave
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Financial & Health Benefits

  • Base for this role ranges from $165,000 - $200,000
  • 401(k) with employer match (50% up to 8%)
  • Medical, dental & vision
  • HSA with company contribution
  • Life and AD&D (2x salary up to $1M)

Join Us

Help build the People Operations foundation for a global industrial tech leader—and play a direct role in shaping the future of modern manufacturing.

Apply today to be part of the transformation.

title: Patient Coordinator
description:
Position Summary:

As a Patient Coordinator at Woven Care, you will be the essential link in maintaining efficient, high-performing schedules that directly support the care and development of our pediatric patients. This role is incredibly fast-paced, and is ideal for someone with a strong ability to prioritize, organize, and adapt to last-minute changes. You’ll bring a passion for helping others and an understanding of how daily operations contribute to long-term success, making decisions rooted in data and performance outcomes to ensure our services are accessible and impactful for the families we serve.

Compensation and Benefits Information:

  • Base compensation: $21-$23/hour
  • Performance-based bonuses
  • Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with company match
  • Additional benefits include paid time off, professional development allowance, and flexible work arrangements

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Optimized Scheduling: Proactively manage patient schedules, including daily and weekly appointment coordination, recurring and follow-up appointments, and re-evaluations. Monitor and adjust schedules to maximize service and availability and ensure seamless continuity of care.
  • Last-Minute Adjustments: Respond to cancellations and no-shows quickly and efficiently, filling open slots with waitlisted or make-up appointments whenever possible. Engage with families to reschedule missed sessions, aiming to minimize gaps in therapy.
  • Data-Driven Decisions: Use data insights to guide scheduling practices, analyze patterns, and make informed adjustments that align with high performance and organizational goals. Apply outcome-based thinking to optimize schedules and contribute to the clinic’s operational success.
  • Effective Communication: Confidently communicate with families regarding attendance policies, financial responsibilities, and insurance coverage, ensuring transparency and professionalism in every interaction. Approach challenging conversations with empathy, patience, and clarity.
  • High-Performance Standards: Strive to meet or exceed scheduling efficiency and patient engagement goals, continuously evaluating and improving scheduling practices to support Woven Care’s standards for quality and accessibility in care.
  • Confidentiality and Compliance: Ensure all patient interactions and record-keeping adhere to confidentiality and healthcare compliance guidelines, supporting Woven Care’s commitment to ethical and patient-centered care.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Education: High School diploma or equivalent required; Bachelor’s degree in a related field preferred.
  • Experience: Prior experience in healthcare or a role focused on scheduling, prioritization, and managing client relationships is highly valued.
  • Skills:
    • Organizational Agility: Strong ability to manage multiple priorities with a focus on scheduling accuracy, productivity, and proactive adjustments to meet patient needs.
    • Analytical Mindset: Proficient in using data to make scheduling decisions, drive continuous improvement, and meet performance targets.
    • Effective Communication: Skilled at having clear, professional conversations with families to ensure they understand attendance and payment policies and are supported in adhering to their therapy plan.
    • Resilience and Adaptability: Thrives in a dynamic environment, capable of adapting to sudden changes in scheduling and proactively finding solutions to maintain service continuity.
    • Team-Oriented: Collaborative and dedicated to contributing to a high-energy, focused team that is committed to excellence in patient support.

Schedule:

  • Full-time, non-exempt – 40-hour weeks
  • Monday – Friday 8:00 am – 6:00 pm availability required.

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times

At Woven Care, we've intentionally built a culture that embraces challenges: we're driven by excellence while encouraging fun (we do work with kids, after all!). We believe deeply in the day-to-day impact of our work while also providing opportunities for long-term career growth and leadership opportunities for our team members. We offer real flexibility and manageable workloads for our team, while supporting our mission through collaboration and connection. We think this is what makes Woven Care such a special place to work and why such special people choose to work with us!
